It is part of the premium range of bottom rods. You should definitely check out this magnificent combination of power and distance of casting!

gear.name: UL-CHUBER™ X-Series Whisperer™
gear.description: This top model of the highest quality seems to mesmerize the fish, forcing it to appear among your catch in record time. This exemplary universal rod is a true dream of a professional. The model has excellent balance, sits perfectly in the hand, performs easy and accurate casts. It certainly doesn't afraid of big loads and truly large fish. Today it is actually the pinnacle of the evolution among feeder rods.

gear.name: Garry Scott™ Ardix
gear.description: Part of Garry Scott™ GSLex® specialized range, Ardix™ series presents new and amazingly powerful match rods with perfect casting actions and unrivaled performance capabilities. Featuring light-to-medium actioned blanks that are versatile and designed for diverse fishing, unique carbon fiber material shaped by our revolutionary FormFlex® technology along with the NFT® lightweight guides and an ergonomic secure grip handle, making the Ardix™a series of genuinely high performance match rods.

gear.name: Garry Scott™ Brutus
gear.description: Part of the GSLex® range, the Brutus™ is yet another beautiful series of float rods featuring well-balanced faultless action, unmatched power and an outstanding price-performance ratio. These ultra durable match rods with perfectly balanced action are versatile and designed for diverse fishing and are just the choice for those aimed at catching some big fish. The MegaResin® carbon fiber blank shaped by our revolutionary FormFlex® technology and complemented with an ergonomic secure grip handle guarantees a true high performance rod. This is a superb match rod series comes in a wide selection to suit a wide range of angling preferences.

gear.name: Garry Scott™ Nero
gear.description: This limited series of premium float rods belongs to our GSPlatinex® ultra top line, which means unprecedented durability, lightness and all the benefits of Garry Scott™ unique hi-end technologies. Each and every float rod from the Nero™ series is extremely lightweight and super strong. The FormFlex® shaped design of the ultra slim NanoForce® blank diameter is further enhanced by the UZZ® pattern technology to give you a superbly balanced, resilient and lightweight rod ideally suited for light to medium heavy float fishing. GSPlatinex® Nero™ series is available in three models with a wide range of options.

gear.name: Garry Scott™ EquatorMatch™
gear.description: If you’ve been looking for a match rod for Equatorial African fishing, the engineers at Garry Scott™ have good news for you! The new EquatorMatch™ is a small, neat, and precise tool, made incredibly reliable thanks to the unique NanoForceTitanium® ultra-lightweight and megastrong guide system. This fishing rod has amazing power, and when the size of the river fauna is impressive, this is the type of tackle to guarantee an outstanding catch!

gear.name: RIVERTEX™ Fenix
gear.description: An opening range of Rivermatch® high-quality float rods, the Fenix® float rod series has been made using the latest MaxCarbon® high-modulus carbon fiber alloys and ResinFix® unique curing technology to give you light blanks of significant power for optimal float angling performance. Complete with FGS® guide system and top grade cork handles for improved grip, these float rods are a superb value with plenty of power, balanced action and good line control.

gear.name: RIVERTEX™ Majesty™
gear.description: Majesty™ is a much-awaited new and superb addition to the Rivermatch™ premium line of match rods from Rivertex™. A high-quality versatile match rod, Majesty™ features a super light and powerful blank made with the latest MaxCarbon™ high-modulus carbon fiber alloys and ResinFix™ unique curing technology to ensure optimal angling performance. Complete with FGS™ guide system and top-grade handles for improved grip, this exceptional rod is the perfect balance between power, precision and control.

gear.name: RIVERTEX™ SpellLauncher™
gear.description: The elegant novelty for tropical waters by RIVERTEX™ is a classic three-piece rod for match fishing! The graphite rod is equipped with high-rise guides for an excellent line flow. This small rod with a pleasant cork handle allows you to cast real far both from the shore and from the boat. It is essential for catching large fish that prefer to keep further from the shore, like Brycon or Tambaqui.

gear.name: Flaggmann™ OmniFloat
gear.description: This rod series is ideal for all types of float fishing and provides excellent control over floats. The tree-piece fishing rod features a muscular and powerful extra long blank made of high modulus carbon and comes with an ergonomic screw reel seat, ceramic lined graphite guides and hybrid EVA foam grips for improved performance and comfort.

gear.name: Garry Scott™ X-Series FireArrow™
gear.description: This supreme performance match rod belongs to the exclusive X-Series of professional fishing tackle that is meant to be handled only by Tournament winners! And no wonder - with unmatched casting distance and paramount performance potential, this is by far the most powerful match rod ever created!

gear.name: Garry Scott™ Nero Sport
gear.description: Presenting the much awaited sports series of fishing rods with a chic and stylish black-n-white design that puts emphasis on the word SPORT in sportfishing! This sportfishing rod is twice as strong and durable as its original predecessor. Part of the GSPlatinex® ultra top line, the Nero™ is a limited premium series of match rods that are super lightweight and unbelievably strong. The FormFlex® advanced design of the NanoForce® slim blank is further enhanced by the UZZ® pattern technology to give you a superbly balanced, resilient and lightweight rod ideally suited for making long casts with floats. GSPlatinex® Nero™ series is available in three models with a wide range of options.

gear.name: RIVERTEX™ Fire Fenix
gear.description: A limited Halloween edition of Fenix™, the popular rod designed by Rivertex for match fishing. This Fenix rose from the ashes to help you catch the biggest of Halloween Monster Gars!

gear.name: Garry Scott™ IrishClover
gear.description: Even if you’re not that into St. Patrick’s Day, the IrishClover® match rod is one reason why you’re gonna love it this year! The special holiday blank design with cute lucky horseshoes and clovers will serve as your token of good luck that’s sure to boost your spirits up regardless of whether you consider the day to be an actual holiday! Not to mention that the lightweight design of the carbon fiber blank with perfectly balanced moderate-fast action makes the IrishClover® ideal for diverse fishing when going after trophy monsters like catfish or gar.

gear.name: Garry Scott™ GoldPot
gear.description: GoldPot® is a limited St. Patrick’s Day Edition match rod that’s quite a feast for the eyes! With this luckiest looking angling tool you are sure to stand out from the crowd and bring dazzling rainbow joy to the masses. While an original design makes this rod symbolize a pot of gold at the end of the rainbow, the real magic is in this rod’s fantastic characteristics! Jam packed with leading edge technologies, this tool is sure to serve you long and well, attracting your dream catches as well as admiring glances of all other anglers!

gear.name: Garry Scott™ GreenBeer
gear.description: Celebrate Saint Patrick’s Day with our limited edition GreenBeer® match rod, exclusively designed for the fortunate holiday occasion. This limited St. Patrick’s Day edition angling tool features an awesome flamboyant design to boost up that luck-bearing spirit! Not to mention, this is one powerful high performance rod ready to handle some heavy load float fishing! The GreenBeer® match rod is one real leprechaun trap for your trophy monster.

gear.name: Garry Scott™ MCT McCarp™
gear.description: Garry Scott™ presents the limited MCT tournament edition carp rod to mark the occasion of this September’s first ever Carp cyberfishing competitive event! This unique champion-potential rod is a mighty powerful fishing tool exclusively designed in the style and color theme of Mighty Carp Tour - all to make sure you’re armed with the best equipment for catching this tricky critter! Superb casting action and unrivaled performance capacity make the MCT McCarp™ carp rod an extremely versatile collectible with genuinely high performance fit for a confident Tournament winner.

gear.name: Garry Scott™ GGC MatchMonster™
gear.description: You are holding the limited Tournament edition match rod that was created by Garry Scott™ in the wake of Gars&Glory Cup as beastily muscular gar catching weapon! Featuring ultra powerful casting potential, well-balanced faultless action, and a lightweight blank for the most victorious performance ever, this high performance angling tool for catching the biggest monster gars also boasts exclusive GGC design that makes it a true collectible worthy of glorious Champions!

gear.name: Garry Scott™ SCT DeepCrawler™
gear.description: Gary Scott™ is boasting yet another limited Spring Cats Tour tournament edition of one of the most powerful match rods ever made. This exclusive tool’s unique design is stylishly branded to match the theme and colors of the SCT catfishing Tournament, this spring’s first and most exciting competitive fishing event! Not only does the DeepCrawler™ feature a brand new collectible design to die for, but is also boast unmatched casting potential to maximize the odds of landing a real trophy Cat!

gear.name: RIVERTEX™ SkeleHand™
gear.description: A limited Halloween edition match rod with ultra powerful action for catching some of the biggest resurrected monster gars! Spooky exclusive design makes this superb rod look like a bony arm of justice that’ll reach out and give you a haunted upper hand when match fishing for the biggest of Halloween Monster Gars!

gear.name: Garry Scott™ ChocolateBar™
gear.description: This match masterpiece ChocolateBar™ by the leading manufacturer of float rods GarryScott™ is not likely to melt in your hands, but will instead help you bring in really large fish! A most solid core of carbon fiber makes the rod simultaneously ultra durable, surprisingly flexible and light, while titanium guides will be sure to not let any predator go!

gear.name: RIVERTEX™ X-Series MatchWinner
gear.description: This classic 3-piece graphite rod from RIVERTEX™ will be presented to winners who achieve the best results in match fishing. Tall guides provide excellent line passage, while a nice and comfortable cork handle allows you to cast to the maximum distance both from the shore and from the boat. If you are a fan of large catches and prefer to stay far away from the shore, then this rod is for you!

gear.name: RIVERTEX™ LBFC AquaBreeze™ XL
gear.description: Designed specifically for the Live Bait Fiesta Cup, the LBFC AquaBreeze™ XL 450 match rod by Rivertex™ is a perfect example of high performance fishing tackle. The body of this extremely strong and at the same time quite flexible rod is made of a lightweight material. Thanks to the special design of the blank benefitting from the ResinFix™ technology, the rod has perfect sensitivity during retrieves and bites. In addition, the proprietary ForceGuide® technology, which ensures perfect casting accuracy and prevents rapid wear of the line, makes this rod the pinnacle of modern technology.

gear.name: Wicked Viking
gear.description: Forged for the bravest warriors of the Halloween seas, the Wicked Viking™ match rod features a Viking-inspired design with runes and dragon motifs, embodying the raw strength and fearless spirit of the ancient Norse. Created to defeat the strongest opponents, Wicked Viking™ is designed specifically for battling the monstrous Armored Bighead. Its powerful action and sturdy construction give you the advantage of reeling in this giant as if Odin himself is guiding your hand. Prepare to face stormy waters with courage and unleash your inner Viking this Halloween!

gear.name: Tsurihito™ Kōdo Kyatchā
gear.description: The Japanese company Tsurihito™ is one of the oldest and largest manufacturers developing extra heavy rods. One of them is Kōdo Kyatchā from the exclusive Kōdo series, made with SamuraiDo® technology. Eight reinforcement layers of high modulus polyethylene “gel fiber”, carbon fabric and polymer resin provide the rod with exceptional strength and amazing flexibility. This is a powerful rod with a light and strong blank, equipped with guides with silicon carbide inserts that help avoid line tangles. This unique powerful spinning rod will become an indispensable tackle for many sea fishing enthusiasts.

gear.name: Fletch and Bradford™ BreakwaterX
gear.description: Engineered for long-distance casting, these rods excel both from shore and boat, providing effortless control and sensitivity. Featuring DynamicCore™, the blank is constructed with advanced lightweight composites, offering excellent flexibility to absorb sudden movements without sacrificing strength. FaVector™ reinforces the rod with high-tensile polymer layers, ensuring a perfect balance between power and sensitivity—allowing anglers to detect subtle bites while maintaining complete control over their catch. With an ergonomic, non-slip EVA handle and a perfectly balanced design, this rod delivers comfort, precision, and reliability in every cast.

gear.name: Tsurihito™ MizuJigu
gear.description: A set of short yet powerful saltwater spinning rods designed for handling medium to large fish. Built for balance and sensitivity, they combine cutting-edge materials with advanced engineering to maximize casting efficiency and durability. Featuring HikariFlex™, these rods utilize ultra-thin graphene layers for strength, allowing anglers to detect the lightest bites while maintaining full control. TensaiCore™ reinforces the blank with multidirectional carbon fiber and nanoceramic layers, ensuring durability under extreme pressure. The TatsukoGrip™ ergonomic handle offers a secure, fatigue-free grip, making long fishing sessions more comfortable.

gear.name: Njörinvik™ Asgard™
gear.description: Asgard™ is a high-performance spinning rod perfectly suited for vertical jigging and dominating deep-water predators. Built on an ultra-dense carbon composite blank, it balances strength with refined sensitivity for luring predators from the depths. The BergRygg® reinforced backbone channels lifting power through the core, reducing mid-section flex during aggressive hook-ups. Frostbind® multi-layer coating protects joints and guides from salt, corrosion, and harsh temperature swings.

gear.name: Njörinvik™ Midgard™
gear.description: Midgard™ is a spinning rod designed for inshore and medium-action fishing with the backbone needed for vertical jigging. Built on a responsive graphite blank, it offers the perfect balance of sensitivity and control. StrikeCap® reinforcement at the tip absorbs impact from aggressive strikes and sudden hooksets, protecting the blank from stress fractures. The StødigFoam® non-slip handle coating ensures steady control in all weather, providing all-day comfort whether you're casting from shore or boat.

gear.name: Tsurihito™ Kōdo Tatsu Umi Pro
gear.description: The Kōdo Tatsu Umi Pro casting rod from the latest Kōdo series by the leading Japanese manufacturer Tsurihito™ will captivate casting saltwater fishing enthusiasts with its unique properties. The rod delivers exceptional balance and power while still looking sleek. The innovative technology of applying each of the eight composite reinforcing layers to the rod provides it with the highest strength and flexibility. The unique placement of the guides allows you to use not only fishing lines, but also thin braided cords without problems and overlaps.

gear.name: Tsurihito™ Torii Dai-Kichi
gear.description: The Torii Dai-Kichi casting rod is functional, reliable and designed with predatory sea fishing in mind. Its high-tech blank is made of a composite material carbon prepreg, which makes the rod lightweight and sensitive. The long rod handle and fairly wide butt are ergonomic and fit comfortably in the hand. The Japanese believe that the decorative ornament of the sacred Tori gate brings good luck and blessings to the owner!

gear.name: Tsurihito™ Kōdo Kage
gear.description: Designed for high-power offshore trolling, this saltwater casting rod delivers strength and precision for battling extra-large fish. The curved butt section provides better leverage, reducing strain during prolonged fights. Its medium length balances power and control. Built with TensaiCore™, the multi-directional carbon fiber core ensures high durability under heavy loads. The RyuKen™-reinforced tip adds strength while maintaining flexibility for precise hook sets. TatsukoGrip™ high-density EVA handle offers a secure hold, even in wet conditions. Made for deep-sea trolling, this rod is built to handle the ocean's toughest predators.

gear.name: Fletch and Bradford™ Tri-Flex Graphite
gear.description: Fletch and Bradford™ Tri-Flex Graphite

gear.name: Fletch and Bradford™ MaxFlow X-treme
gear.description: Fletch and Bradford™ MaxFlow X-treme

gear.name: Fletch and Bradford™ Ocean Fury
gear.description: FaBula Ocean Fury from Fletch and Bradford™ (FaB) is a superb elegant trolling rod that guarantees you an unforgettable sea fishing experience! Made using FaBrilliant® technology, this rod has extraordinary flexibility and stretch with exceptional strength, as well as moisture resistance and increased anti-shock properties. In addition to powerful guides, the rod is equipped with a roller at the base of the blank and a roller tip for fishing line, made of heavy-duty material that can withstand heavy loads under extreme sea fishing conditions. This rod truly is a guarantee of fishing success!

gear.name: Fletch and Bradford™ ReefRider Max
gear.description: The ReefRider Max trolling rod from Fletch and Bradford™ (FaB) is a masterpiece of engineering and design. Developed to perform in the toughest conditions, this rod is equipped with a complete set of roller guides and a saltwater resistant roller tip. Innovations were used in the manufacturing process, including the Ultra Resonance System® technology, as the use of composite high-modulus materials made it possible to obtain unique properties of the rod: the ability to instantly return to its original position after peak loads, plasticity, and high sensitivity!

gear.name: Tsurihito™ Ryōshi Kaito HJ
gear.description: The Ryōshi Kaito HJ is a powerful short rod from the leading Japanese fishing tackle manufacturer Tsurihito™. The innovative technologies used in its production make this rod a unique tackle for bottom sea fishing. The nanofibers used to reinforce the rod with NanoFlexyPoint® technology create an incredibly strong and flexible construction. The rod is equipped with a complete set of reinforced roller guides and a roller tip that can withstand heavy loads under extreme fishing conditions. All tackle is treated with a special anti-corrosion protective layer against the aggressive marine environment, which increases the performance of the rod.

gear.name: Fletch and Bradford™ AquaStrike FJ
gear.description: Fletch and Bradford™ (FaB) has released this AquaStrike FJ short bottom rod at an attractive price. It’s perfect for fishing in conditions where it is impossible to swing far enough when casting and throw the bait far. Made with alternating layers of fiberglass, this sleek looking rod is strong enough to take on big fish. The rod is equipped with strong and reliable guides that resist unexpected and heavy loads to withstand the significant weight of the fish. The perfect combination of quality and price!

gear.name: AquaVolt™ PulseWave™
gear.description: PulseWave™ is a saltwater bottom casting E-ROD that features a CoreCharge® system inside the handle to power your E-REEL directly, maintaining a balanced setup even during intense battles. With SmartClick® direct-mount tech, the reel snaps into place in one smooth motion, activating power and data transfer. Reinforced by TorqueArc® architecture, PulseWave™ keeps its shape under stress, distributing force evenly and preventing torsion.

gear.name: AquaVolt™ Chillarc™
gear.description: Chillarc™ is a saltwater bottom casting E-ROD made of a responsive carbon-composite blank that offers excellent sensitivity and controlled flex. Equipped with the CoreCharge® integrated battery system, Chillarc™ delivers clean, uninterrupted power to your E-REEL directly through the handle. VoltSnap® charging tech keeps the internal system cool and efficient, minimizing downtime between sessions.

gear.name: AquaVolt™ Sigma F™
gear.description: Compact and effortlessly easy to handle, Sigma F™ is the go-to saltwater bottom casting E-ROD for casual fishing. It offers a carbon-composite blank that delivers smooth action and great feel when targeting ocean predators. The fluorescent tip enhances bite detection in low light, giving you a visual edge when fishing after dark. Equipped with SmartClick®, the reel mounts in one seamless motion with instant power and data activation. The built-in VoltSnap® charging system maximizes efficiency, keeping your rod charged and ready with minimal downtime.

gear.name: Tsurihito™ KarasuTōha
gear.description: Designed for challenging offshore conditions, this short yet incredibly strong rod provides maximum control over heavy fish while maintaining sensitivity for precise bait presentation. Featuring HikariFlex™ infused construction, this rod remains lightweight without compromising durability, allowing anglers to detect even the slightest movements. TensaiCore™ multi-directional carbon reinforcement ensures superior strength, handling extreme loads with ease. The ergonomic TatsukoGrip™ EVA handle provides a secure and comfortable grip, reducing fatigue during intense fights.

gear.name: Fletch and Bradford™ Commander
gear.description: Designed for long-distance casting and versatility, this rod excels in both boat and shore fishing. Its durable yet lightweight construction provides the perfect balance of power and sensitivity, making it ideal for targeting medium to large fish. FaVortex™ technology enhances casting accuracy by optimizing the rod's aerodynamics, ensuring smooth, controlled long-range casts. Meanwhile, FaLineFlow™ minimizes friction with precision-placed guides, improving line release and maximizing casting distance. Reinforced with corrosion-resistant components, this rod is built to withstand the toughest saltwater conditions while delivering reliable performance.

gear.name: Katana Soul
gear.description: Katana Soul™ is a limited edition saltwater spinning rod designed for Halloween brave anglers! Inspired by the legendary Japanese katana, this rod is adorned with intricate patterns and ancient symbols, echoing the spirit of samurai warriors. Created to combine strength and precision, it is perfect for battling the terrifying sea monster Akkorokamui. The soul of the katana lives within this rod, giving its owner the strength and courage needed to tame the ocean depths. Whether you’re braving the haunted waters or battling the monster itself, Katana Soul™ will be your reliable ally in this thrilling Halloween adventure!

gear.name: MagFin™ FeatherLight
gear.description: Part of our PrimeSpinn® lux line rod segment, FeatherLight™ is an ultra-light, unbelievably sensitive and yet mega durable spinning rod that allows angling with light line and small baits, yet easily handles large fish in heavy corners. Our breakthrough AirLight® Technology combined with a state of the art GLR® graphene lining reinforcement ensure unseen precision and balance along with optimized action. Complete with world’s most lightweight LGT® guides and our breakthrough EZGuide® system, this is the ultimate high-performance ultra-light spinning rod on the market!

gear.name: MagFin™ JigWinner
gear.description: Part of the UltraSpinn® line, this leading edge rod series is designed to be fished with jigs. All JigWinner™ rods are light-weight and powerful with medium to light action, perfect for use with high speed and super power reels, like MagFin Prima series. The innovative ProSpeed® Construction ensures incredible lightness, and sensitivity along with muscular pulling power and fast recovery rate for jigging action like never before.

gear.name: MagFin™ Elemental
gear.description: Part of the StartSpinn® basic spinning rod line, Elemental™ is a multi-functional versatile spinning rod series perfect for beginner anglers. These high quality reliable rods proudly bear the MagFin name thus ensuring great performance despite their affordability. The strong and durable ProSpeed® blank complimented by the lightness of LGT® guides and superb line control of our unique EZGuide® system give you the strength and feel of a high performance spinning rod.

gear.name: MagFin™ Aguarayo™
gear.description: This short spinning rod with a powerful cast was developed by MagFin™ to take into account all the aspects of fishing in the Amazon and other South American waterways. Its small size allows you to make easy casts from a boat, and the rod has more than enough power to take on aggressive Amazon predators. This spinning rod is characterized by its ability to cast heavy lures for especially large fish.

gear.name: MagFin™ RiverSpear
gear.description: MagFin is proud to present its new unique model, which can easily overshadow all other models! This lightweight spinning rod is reinforced with state-of-the-art GLR® graphene fibers, allowing you to tackle even the biggest prey without the risk of breaking the blank. In addition, the use of a unique guides arrangement with the help of the innovative EZGuide® System technology allows you to make casts that are unprecedented in terms of range and quality. This rod is the perfect combination of strength, weight, and ease of use!

gear.name: Garry Scott™ Aurora
gear.description: This spinning rod series stands for exceptional value, ensuring top-level GSPro® spinning rod performance at wonderful prices. Each Aurora™ blank was developed using Garry Scott™ state of the art UZZ® pattern method and is exceptionally light and powerful due to our carbon fiber MegaResin® technology. The special FormFlex® rod shaping technique ensures superb actions and increased casting distance. Each GSPro® Aurora™ rod is an exquisite delight for any angler designed to achieve casting excellence.

gear.name: RIVERTEX™ Thora
gear.description: Part of our specialized Spinntex® line of ultra high performance spinning rods, Thora® features an ultra slim high modulus MaxCarbon® alloy blank reinforced with ResinFix® unique curing technology to bring you a rod of reduced weight and improved performance. Complete with a lightweight reel seat, FGS Light® guides, quality EVA foam handles and a beautiful glossy finish to top it all, this rod has got the looks to match its fantastic performance!

gear.name: RIVERTEX™ Loki
gear.description: Spinntex® premium line of ultra high performance spinning rods presents Loki® - a new ultra powerful spinning rod that features an ultra slim high modulus MaxCarbon® alloy blank reinforced with ResinFix® unique curing technology. This allowed us to produce a next generation spinning rod blank of unseen strength, light weight and enhanced performance. Complete with a lightweight reel seat, FGS Light® guides, premium-grade EVA handles and a beautiful glossy finish to top it all, this rod has got the looks to match its fantastic performance!

gear.name: RIVERTEX™ Zeus
gear.description: RIVERTEX™ is happy to present Zeus®, the new and most powerful member of the specialized Spinntex® line of ultra high performance spinning rods. Even more muscular than its divine predecessor Loki®, this father of gods features an improved construction of its ultra slim high modulus MaxCarbon® alloy blank. This along with an innovated curing method of ResinFix® reinforcement allowed us to create a rod of increased power and improved performance. Complete with a lightweight reel seat, FGS Light® Gold Edition guides of a more compact diameter, premium-grade NoSlipGrip™ handles and a beautiful glossy finish, Zeus® has got the godly looks to match its olympic performance!

gear.name: RIVERTEX™ Thetis™
gear.description: Rivertex™ presents Thetis™ - the new and most powerful yet spinning rod that bears the name of a mighty sea goddess! An all-round superior choice for spin angling, this beauty is perfect for catching feisty beasts like trophy-sized bass, pike, salmon and muskies! Packed with Rivertex™ leading-edge technologies, like the ultra slim high modulus MaxCarbon™ alloy blank and the ResinFix™ reinforcement method, this superb masterpiece of a rod features divine design to match its superior performance!

gear.name: Flaggmann™ ValueSpin
gear.description: The ValueSpin® rods are a balance of durability, quality and price – a combination that gives you the best value and comfortable performance in spinning rods. Combining a lightweight high modulus graphite blank with quality EVA foam handles, the ValueSpin® rod series is perfect for all bait applications. You’ll love it for its unique combination of affordability, strength and sensitivity.

gear.name: RIVERTEX™ NileChasseur™
gear.description: Rivertex™ presents its incredible spinning rod NileChasseur™, designed specifically for enormous Nile Perch specimens. Its creators have considered all aspects of fishing in Equatorial Africa, boosting the power and durability of the rod. The company’s signature MaxCarbon® technology has greatly amplified these characteristics, allowing the NileChasseur™ to reliably handle hefty fish. Thanks to the proven ResinFix® curing process, this African beast can help you land trophies of any weight.

gear.name: RIVERTEX™ X-Series Rocket™
gear.description: X-Series Rocket™ is a prime performance Tournament-level spinning rod with unlike any you’ve ever seen! Featuring hi-end blank construction and top notch technologies that provide for unmatched casting potential, making this spinning rod the most far casting fishing tool ever! X-Series Rocket™ is so exclusive, it can’t be bought. It can only be won by the best of anglers.

gear.name: Garry Scott™ Aurora Sport
gear.description: Presenting the much awaited sports series of fishing rods with a chic and stylish black-n-white design that puts emphasis on the word SPORT in sportfishing! This sportfishing rod is twice as strong and durable as its original predecessor. This spinning rod series stands for exceptional value, ensuring top-level GSPro® spinning rod performance at wonderful prices. Each Aurora™ blank was developed using Garry Scott™ state of the art UZZ® pattern method and is exceptionally light and powerful due to our carbon fiber MegaResin® technology. The special FormFlex® rod shaping technique ensures superb actions and increased casting distance. Each GSPro® Aurora™ rod is an exquisite delight for any angler designed to achieve casting excellence.

gear.name: MagFin™ FeatherLight Sport
gear.description: Presenting the much awaited sports series of fishing rods with a chic and stylish black-n-white design that puts emphasis on the word SPORT in sportfishing! This sportfishing rod is twice as strong and durable as its original predecessor. Part of our PrimeSpinn lux line rod segment, Sport Edition FeatherLight™ is an ultra-light, unbelievably sensitive and yet mega durable spinning rod that allows angling with light line and small baits, yet easily handles large fish in heavy corners. Our breakthrough AirLight® Technology combined with a state of the art GLR® graphene lining reinforcement ensure unseen precision and balance along with optimized action. Complete with world’s most lightweight LGT® guides and our breakthrough EZGuide® system, this is the ultimate high-performance ultra-light spinning rod on the market!

gear.name: MagFin™ NightFeather™ Edition
gear.description: NightFeather™ is a superior ultra-light spinning rod, designed for the ultimately satisfying night fishing experience! Unbelievably sensitive and ultra durable at the same time, NightFeather™ Golden Edition combines AirLight™ blank technology with our GLR™ graphene lining reinforcement to ensure unseen precision and balanced action. This high-performance spinning rod boasts an exclusive design, available only as part of the Golden FP Pack and has a cool golden glow-in-the-dark tip to brighten up your night fishing experience and ensure a radiant lighting effect all night long!

gear.name: RIVERTEX™ Loki™ Edition
gear.description: This ultra high-performance spinning rod of the Spinntex™ premium line now comes in the new Golden Edition! Unbelievably powerful, Loki™ Golden Edition features an ultra slim high modulus MaxCarbon alloy blank reinforced with ResinFix unique curing technology. Aside from unmatched strength, light weight and enhanced performance, this gem of a spinning rod boasts a cool black&gold collectible design, available exclusively as a part of the Golden FP Pack, and has ultimately got the looks to match its fantastic performance!

gear.name: RIVERTEX™ Golden Zeus™
gear.description: Welcome the new Golden Edition of Zeus™ NE - one of the most powerful and all-round superior spinning rods with the night fishing feature. Boasting some leading-edge technologies, like the ultra slim high modulus MaxCarbon™ alloy blank and the ResinFix™reinforcement method, this godly masterpiece of a rod features stunning design, available exclusively as part of the Golden FP Pack and has a unique golden glow-in-the-dark tip to brighten up your night fishing experience and ensure a radiant lighting effect all night long!

gear.name: RIVERTEX™ Candy Cane
gear.description: CandyCane® is a limited Christmas Edition spinning rod that’s quite a feast for the eyes! With this sweet looking angling tool you are sure to stand out from the crowd and bring candy joy to the masses! While an original design makes this rod resemble a real oversized candy cane, the tastiest part is in fact this rod’s fantastic characteristics! Jam packed with leading edge technologies, this tool is sure to serve you long and well, attracting your dream catches as well as admiring glances of all other anglers!

gear.name: RIVERTEX™ Merry Tree
gear.description: Say ho, ho, ho! and welcome the MerryTree® spinning rod - a limited holiday edition angling tool with an awesome festive Christmas Tree design to boost up that holiday spirit! Not to mention, this is one powerful high performance rod! Lightweight design, high modulus Carbon reinforced blank and a unique resin curing process used in this super gadget’s creation will have you landing Trophies with ease and guarantee an uplifted mood throughout the Christmas holidays and beyond!

gear.name: RIVERTEX™ Salmonster™
gear.description: Salmonster™ is the ultimately powerful spinning rod made for going after all the big bad Salmon. Be it Chinook, Chum or Sockeye, the Salmonster™ can withstand huge pressure and handle the weight of even the heaviest of red giants. The innovations and improved technologies behind the construction and curing of this Salmon-catching miracle are truly state-of-the-art in powerful fishing tackle manufacturing. But aside superb performance, it’s the Salmonster™’s unique design inspired by Fishing Planet Anniversary Cup that make this spinning rod a real collectible. All in all, unmatched power and superior performance are why the Salmonster™ is the number one choice for any Salmon fishing competition.

gear.name: RIVERTEX™ WPT PowerEsox®
gear.description: This is a deluxe collectible edition of one of the most powerful spinning rods on the market made by RIVERTEX™. The exclusive Tournament level spinning rod is stylishly branded to match the colors of Winter Pike Tour - the ultimate Pike fishing competitive event of this winter! The ultimate force construction blank makes this rod an extremely powerful fishing weapon, while ultra light guides within a unique line control system provide for smoother retrieves and considerably longer casts, offering Tournament-level performance!

gear.name: MagFin™ WPT PikeWinner
gear.description: MagFin™ presents a limited Tournament edition spinning rod with a unique design stylishly branded to match the colors of Winter Pike Tour - the ultimate Pike fishing competitive event of this winter! The WPT Pike Winner is not just a pretty face. The innovative construction ensures incredible lightness and sensitivity along with muscular pulling power and fast recovery rate for jigging action like never before. This leading edge collectible rod is lightweight and powerful to match a true champion’s Tournament performance!

gear.name: RIVERTEX™ CCO ChargerBlade™
gear.description: The month of may is here and as spring is almost at its end, RIVERTEX™ presents CCO ChargerBlade™ - the unique spinning rod made exclusively in the wake of one of the most exciting fishing tournaments you’ll see this year! This Char Charger’s Open edition powerful angling tool is enough to get anyone excited. Not only does the ChargerBlade™ feature a brand new collectible design to die for, but is also boast unmatched casting potential to maximize the odds of landing a real Trophy!

gear.name: RIVERTEX™ CCO NRGizer™
gear.description: RIVERTEX™ is boasting yet another Char Charger’s Open tournament edition of one of the most powerful spinning rods ever made. This exclusive tool’s unique design is stylishly branded to match the theme and colors of the CCO Char fishing Tournament, this spring season’s final and most exciting yet competitive fishing event! The super rod’s brand new design matches the competitive occasion making this piece a genuine collectible! Not to mention that powerful casting potential and overall magnificent performance of the NRGizer™ ensure a real winner’s performance!

gear.name: RIVERTEX™ SpookySpin™
gear.description: SpookySpin™ limited edition spinning rod is this Halloween’s absolute must-have! Made specifically for spookiest event, this awesome thematic fishing tool features cool spooks’n’ghost design to summon that adventurous halloween spirit of the inner child we all have deep within! And oh boy, will that magic spirit come in handy when catching Ghost Pikes!

gear.name: RIVERTEX™ CGT MonSpin™
gear.description: Christmas is almost here and this holiday season bring us the new Tournament edition spinning rod CGT MonSpin™ from RIVERTEX™. This unique super powerful angling tool was made exclusively in the wake of one of the most heavyweight fishing tournament you’ve ever seen! This Christmas Giant’s Tour edition spinning rod has all the titanic potential necessary for landing those Trophies and Uniques! Not only does the MonSpin™ feature a super cool collectible design, but is also boast unmatched casting potential to help you battled the supersized monsters!

gear.name: RIVERTEX™ DracoSpin
gear.description: Fantastic performance, powerful casting potential and a unique collectible design to die for - this high performance spinning rod made of premium grade carbon has it all! Part of the exclusive edition Golden Dragon Pack, with DracoSpin spinning rod you’ll have the power of the Dragon right in your hands.

gear.name: RIVERTEX™ FPBS FireZeus™
gear.description: As soon as your fingers touch this new Rivertex™ spinning rod, you can’t help but exclaim “this thing is on fire!”. And you will have every reason to do so: FireZeus™ 270 is a powerful rod undeniably superior to its predecessors. It is rightly named after the chief Olympian himself, just look at its parameters! It features an improved ultra strong carbon blank, more compact FGS Light® Gold Edition guides with black inlays and premium anti-slip handles NoSlipGrip™… Don’t forget the innovative curing method that allows the rod to withstand extreme weights. To top it off, enjoy the exquisite lacquer finish and stylish fiery aerography!

gear.name: Uncle Sam
gear.description: UncleSam™ is a limited Independence Day Edition spinning rod that’s quite a feast for the eyes! Decorated with Stars and Stripes - key national symbols of the USA, this powerful spinning rod boasts lightweight design, high modulus Carbon reinforced blank and overall high performance characteristics. The unique resin curing process used in this super gadget’s creation will have you landing Trophies this Independence Day like no other spinning rod!

gear.name: RIVERTEX™ CombatLoki™ Available only for The Fisherman Fishing Planet
gear.description: RIVERTEX™ CombatLoki™ Available only for The Fisherman Fishing Planet

gear.name: RIVERTEX™ TrophySpinn™ Available only for The Fisherman Fishing Planet
gear.description: RIVERTEX™ TrophySpinn™ Available only for The Fisherman Fishing Planet

gear.name: RIVERTEX™ LuckySpin
gear.description: Equipped with luck and our best tackle, we set off to catch the cunning Snakehead. You are holding an incredibly powerful limited edition spinning rod with a special festive design. The attractive combination of emerald green and gold makes it feel like you are holding a truly enchanted thing, possessing the magic of a lucky golden horseshoe!

gear.name: RIVERTEX™ TWKC BeastMaster™
gear.description: Excellent performance and stylish design is what sets this Rivertex™ spinning rod apart. Lightweight core made from extra light MaxCarbon™ alloy and special ResinFix™ reinforcement technology was literally made for tournaments like the Topwater Kayak Cup. This rod will undoubtedly lead you to success in catching even the most difficult fish!

gear.name: MagFin™ X-Series RiverLine
gear.description: This rod from MagFin™ is the perfect prize for tournament winners! This spinning rod is specially designed to deal with extra large fish. Its main advantage is ultra-precise and extremely powerful casting even with heavy bait! Despite its small size, this rod can land even very aggressive and heavy fish, such as Amazonian predators. Strength and durability, comfortable grip, modern design — the list of its advantages can go on.

gear.name: Black Needle
gear.description: This rod combines sturdy technology with subtle traditional Ukrainian designs inspired by fish and water motifs, elegantly woven into its sleek black and red finish. Crafted with freshwater trolling in mind, the Black Needle 230 offers exceptional strength, sensitivity, and lightweight performance. Designed to pair seamlessly with the Scarlet Thread 7000 spinning reel—just as a needle and thread go together—and to pay homage to traditional Ukrainian embroidery crafted with black and red threads.

gear.name: UL-CHUBER™ Power Launcher Spod
gear.description: Power Launcher Spod™ is a state-of-the-art spodding rod from UL-CHUBER™ that is designed for accurately depositing huge amounts of free bait and attract even more fish! Built for maximum strength, power and incredible precision, the Power Launcher™ features a technological ProtoFibre™ blank cured with the HyperTension™ high frequency method, specially reinforced OxyAlum™ chrome-plated steel guides and the TrueGrip™ handle for a pleasantly sturdy and powerful grip that is very handy when it comes to making powerful long-distance casts! Power Launcher Spod™ is the ultimate spod rod for accurately baiting the desired area and successfully delivering chum to seemingly unreachable areas!

gear.name: UL-CHUBER™ X-Series Bazooka™
gear.description: This launcher will literally blow your mind about spodding! It has all you need: sturdy construction, ergonomics, pleasant grip, and most importantly – ultra-precise bait launch. What else is needed to name this model the best of its kind!! This tool will give you a confidence in your victory in any competition, allowing you to keep fish at close range for a long time in a variety of weather conditions.

gear.name: Femur
gear.description: This spod rod with a femur handle is a real find for those who are going to fight against the evil spirits that have broken through the otherworldly gate! Light, strong, and at the same time incredibly accurate rod is suitable for casting bait on the target!

gear.name: Garry Scott™ Troy
gear.description: All telescopic rods from the GSLex®Troy™ series are the choice of anglers with a demand for more power to handle bigger fish. These powerful rods feature a slim MegaResin® carbon fiber blank with a superb bending curve via advanced FormFlex® technology. Complete with light and strong GST® titanium guides, Troy™ series is a perfect powerful heavy fishing allrounder with an outstanding price-performance ratio.

gear.name: Garry Scott™ Caesar
gear.description: Part of the GSPlatinex® ultra top line, the Caesar™ is a limited premium series of telescopic match rods that are super lightweight and unbelievably strong. The FormFlex® advanced telescopic design of the NanoForce® slim blank is further enhanced by the UZZ® pattern technology to give you a superbly balanced, resilient and lightweight rod ideally suited for float angling fish like trout, tench, perch and bream. GSPlatinex® Caesar™ series is available in two models with a wide range of options.

gear.name: Flaggmann™ TeleFloat
gear.description: This series brings you the strongest telescopic match rods available from Flaggmann™. Built from high modulus carbon this two-piece series is the ultimate combination of affordability, power and precision. Complete with fully lined guides and ergonomic hybrid handles, the TeleFloat® rods are engineered to quickly pick up line right on the strike, ensuring a great hook-up ratio, not to mention accurate casting capacity. The two-piece blank allows for convenient ready-rigged storage till the next fish fight.

gear.name: Garry Scott™ X-Series Javelin™
gear.description: Congratulations! You are the proud owner of X-Series Javelin™ - a Tournament level telescopic rod with casting potential unlike any you’ve ever seen. This is by far the most professional angling tool that is paramount to any other telescopic rod models.

gear.name: Garry Scott™ Hell Troy
gear.description: This is a limited Halloween edition of Garry Scott Troy™, the all-time favorite telescopic rod straight from hell! Just the powerful angling tool for conquering those Halloween Monster Gars.

gear.name: Flaggmann™ Tomahawk
gear.description: The Thanksgiving edition Tomahawk is one powerful telescopic rod! This versatile fishing weapon is perfect for hand-to-hand combat with the beastliest depth dwellers. Get in touch with your wild tribal spirit just like the majestic indigenous people of North America and let the Tomahawk aid you in all your fishing endeavors! May the Great Spirit be with you!

gear.name: Garry Scott™ Blunderbuss
gear.description: The Blunderbuss is just the caliber for a fearless crusader ready to embark on a real fishing pilgrimage. This Thanksgiving edition telescopic rod is the ultimate tool that will satisfy a true pilgrim’s demand for more power to handle bigger fish! Be a fish conqueror and join the Thanksgiving pilgrimage with the Blunderbuss 600!

gear.name: Garry Scott™ CrazyTurkey
gear.description: Join in on the Thanksgiving holiday spirit with the CrazyTurkey telescopic rod. This highly efficient and powerful angling tool may look and sound like pure fun, but wait till you see it in in action! Durable, light and jam-packed with hi-end technologies, the CrazyTurkey is you ultimate choice for the best Thanksgiving fishing of your life!

gear.name: Garry Scott™ Purple Bat™
gear.description: Purple Bat™ is a new and limited edition telescopic fishing rod that is available to anglers only this Halloween! Featuring a cool purple design with bats and pumpkins to match the occasion, the Purple Bat™ is a super powerful angling tool for conquering Halloween Monster Gars you can really put your bets on!

gear.name: Garry Scott™ TeleDragon™
gear.description: This prime quality ultra powerful telescopic rod from our our exclusive edition Golden Dragon Pack is not only a beautiful collectible, but a true top-performance angling tool with advanced technology at its very core! It takes only one cast to see that TeleDragon will serve its master just like the legendary creature it represents!

gear.name: Garry Scott™ TeleValentine™
gear.description: Gary Scott™ presents this Crappie Valentine Cup edition telescopic rod with a unique design that will be a true manifestation of your deep love for fishing! This exclusive Tournament fishing tool is stylishly branded to match the lovely colors of this Valentine’s Day fishing event! Enjoy superb casting potential and convenient sensitivity to ensure a Crappie fishing champion’s performance!

gear.name: Garry Scott™ Troy™ Edition
gear.description: The new Golden Edition of the all-time favorite telescopic rod Troy™ brings you the exclusive GoldenTroy™ version of your ultimate angling companion! This powerful telescope featuring a slim MegaResin® carbon fiber blank with a superb bending curve via advanced FormFlex® technology is complete with light and strong GST® titanium guides. GoldenTroy™ also boasts a unique black&gold collectible design, available exclusively as a part of the Golden FP Pack, and is the best choice for anglers with a demand for more power to handle bigger fish.

gear.name: MagFin™ Attorney
gear.description: The new Attorney® low profile baitcasting reel series is not only pleasantly affordable, but also features a more compact design and an ultra smooth feel due to advanced technologies within. Part of the MagicReel® line, Attorney® reels feature a lightweight and durable aluminum alloy frame body, full protection from corrosion with the SOS® smart oil seal and a unique MagFin™ B3® backlash prevention system for long casting capacity without line twists. This all-time low profile baitcasting classic is an all-round good choice for those long and precise casts.

gear.name: MagFin™ Fellix
gear.description: Premium but small low profile casting reel. While inherit the classic's functionality and performance, this upgraded reel series is all about combining lightweight construction with unmatched technological power.

gear.name: MagFin™ LowDex
gear.description: Strength, power, reliability and a great value for money - anglers will get full package in the LowDex® basic low profile baitcasting reel series. Part of the MagicReel® line, these reels feature a lightweight and durable aluminum alloy frame body, full protection from corrosion with the SOS® smart oil seal and a unique MagFin™ B3® backlash prevention system for long casting capacity without line twists. An all-round good choice for low profile baitcasting, LowDex® reels ensure terrific performance for their dollar.

gear.name: MagFin™ LowDex MG
gear.description: MagFin™ presents an upgraded series of our classic low profile baitcasting favorite - LowDex®, the new LowDexMG®. Now taken to the next level within the MetaGraf® line, this low profile marvel has the power and strength lying within the MetaGraf® reel body material, the comfort of our XLCast® cast control systems and the force of MagFin™ muscular TRIPPLE DRAG® to ensure ultimate line capacity and maximize overall angling performance. All this along with other advanced technologies make LowDexMG® low profile baitcasting reels a sure means of success on the water, be it salmon, musky or trophy bass that you are after.

gear.name: MagFin™ Counsellor
gear.description: A durable low profile baitcasting reel. This low-profile baitcasting series is part of the MagFin™ MetaGraf® line. Which means unmatched durability due to the technologically unique MetaGraf® frame material. Equipped with a corrosion resistant full-body aluminum alloy MagicSpool® and a twelve ball bearing CorrStop® system for flawless casting performance and efficient cranking, our Counsellor® reels give you super versatile casting potential thanks to the XLCast® control systems. Whether you are angling for bass, walleye, steelhead etc., Counsellor® reels are a great choice for ultimate all-purpose performance on the water.

gear.name: RIVERTEX™ Helios
gear.description: A premium series within the EverCast® reel family, Helios® is a renowned low profile favorite among heavy-duty anglers everywhere. Combining advanced technologies and top quality materials, this compact reel has unmatched fish-fighting potential. Thanks to the RIVERTEX™ original EasyDrag™ system and our NBP® anti-reverse these reels provide rock-solid hookset power and the smoothest drag imaginable. The tough and durable monolithic ARTEX® frame, exclusive ultra light ArtSpool® and state of the art O2® oscillation system make Helios® one of the best low profile reels ever created!

gear.name: RIVERTEX™ VorteX
gear.description: Part of the premium Rondo® round baitcasting line, the VorteX® series offers compact design along with the EasyDrag™ System and renowned StraighLine Duo® Anti Backlash to give you the ultimate casting capacity with unseen accuracy, precision and control. Durable and powerful, with sizes fitted for some diehard cranking, all VorteX® reels have fully-machined, solid-built ARTEX® frames packed with exclusive and super durable tungsten carbide TCBearings® and special ultra light alloy ArtSpool® for the ultimate muscular round baitcasting performance with unmatched rigidity and handling comfort. Complete with our exclusive fully scratch resistant diamond polished TCP® finish.

gear.name: RIVERTEX™ Cyclone

gear.name: RIVERTEX™ Tornado
gear.description: A much awaited top-class newcomer form RIVERTEX, this ultra-powerful casting reel has the name to match its mind blowing potential! Indeed, the Tornado™ boast a renewed and enhanced design with an extra large spool built out of ultra light ArtSpool™ alloy. Featuring the fail-proof EasyDrag™ System and renowned StraighLine Duo™ Anti Backlash for ultimate casting potential with maximum accuracy, precision and control, the Tornado™ has a fully-machined, solid-built ARTEX™ frame packed with exclusive and super durable tungsten carbide TCBearings™ for the ultimate performance and handling comfort. Durable and powerful, this truly amazing baitcasting reel will be just the weapon to equip for battling some of the biggest and most aggressive fish imaginable!

gear.name: RIVERTEX™ PowerGrab™
gear.description: A new and mega powerful casting reel from Rivertex™, the PowerGrab™ boasts delightful accuracy and unmatched precision, making it a lethal weapon for hunting predators. Equipped with all of the top Rivertex™ reel technologies, including EasyDrag™ and renowned StraighLine Duo™ anti backlash system, the PowerGrab™ is encased into a fully-machined, solid-built ARTEX™ frame and features a cool fresh design that ensure utmost durability and chic style!

gear.name: MagFin™ Bailarina
gear.description: Bailarina Baitcasting Reel by MagFin™ is the ultimate combination of power and elegance for your ideal fishing experience! Its steady balanced rotation resembles a dance, while its capabilities are perfectly suited for really large fish. This reel has a durable core and two braking systems, which allows to reduce line tangling when casting. The infinite anti-reverse system will help keep all your trophies in place and make your fishing experience extra fun!

gear.name: RIVERTEX™ X-Series LanceCaster™
gear.description: You’re holding the exclusive X-Series casting reel that is available only to Tournament winners. This exclusive pro-level angling tool is unlike any reel you’ve ever tried! Features a precise drag tuning system and special technological construction that provides more casting potential than any other casting reel on the market!

gear.name: RIVERTEX™ Helios Sport

gear.name: MagFin™ Counsellor Sport

gear.name: MagFin™ Counsellor Edition

gear.name: RIVERTEX™ GoldenTornado™
gear.description: You are holding a new Golden Edition of Tornado™, the top-class ultra-powerful casting reel form RIVERTEX, with a name to match its mind-blowing potential! Available only in the Golden FP Pack, the GoldenTornado™ features an exclusive black&gold design with an extra-large spool built out of ultra-light ArtSpool™ alloy. Featuring the fail-proof EasyDrag™ System and renowned StraighLine Duo™ Anti Backlash for ultimate casting potential with maximum accuracy, precision and control, the GoldenTornado™ will be just the weapon to equip for battling some of the biggest and most aggressive fish imaginable!

gear.name: AmericanEagle™
gear.description: AmericanEagle™ Independence Day edition casting reel is a limited series exclusive piece of tackle to ignite your holiday spirit at first glance! The exclusive patriotic design features America’s main symbols - the Star-Spangled Banner and the Bald Eagle. This magnificent casting reel is more than just candy for the eyes - featuring lightweight design along with high-end technologies this is an overall powerful high-quality angling tool that is sure to help you land some of your biggest fish yet!

gear.name: MagFin™ VBO Reel
gear.description: And yet another exclusive fishing tool from MagFin™ - the limited Tournament edition casting reel to match the occasion of Virtual Bass Open - the ultimate Bass fishing competitive event! Featuring a unique graphene reel body alloy, this strong bass baitcasting reel boasts a frame that is capable of withstanding substantially more pressure and torque than any graphite frame. Virtually indestructible, this reel will never be broken completely aside from the fixable wear-and-tear, thus standing for unprecedented durability and Tournament-level casting performance!

gear.name: MagFin™ LBAC BassShooter
gear.description: The much awaited Bass fishing competitive even is finally here. And MagFin™ combined all its technological advancements to created this limited edition Bass casting reel! Meticulously designed and decorated in the Largemouth Bass April Cup theme, the LBAC BassShooter™ is a genuine Tournament edition collectible that boast unmatched casting potential and precision to maximize the odds of landing a real bad trophy Bass!

gear.name: MagFin™ GSC DynaSwirl™
gear.description: MagFin™ created this limited edition casting reel for the viciously exciting Smallmouth Bass fishing tournament, the Grand Smallie’s Cup. GSC DynaSwirl™ is a top-level dynamic bass reel featuring all the top-notch technological advancements present-day has to offer! Flawlessly designed and decorated in the GSC color theme, the DynaSwirl™ is a true Tournament edition collectible that boast unmatched casting potential, precision and drag power to give you the upper hand when fighting a vicious trophy Smallmouth!

gear.name: MagFin™ Basilisk™
gear.description: This exclusive collectible casting reel features a stylish dragon-themed design and is part of our new Golden Dragon Pack! But Basilisk™ is not just candy for an angler’s eyes, but also a high-performance fishing tool with superb casting control and unmatched durability to match its powerful name!

gear.name: RIVERTEX™ CGT BBgun™
gear.description: RIVERTEX™ created this limited edition huge-caliber casting reel for the big-league heavyweight fishing Tournament of this Holiday Season, the Christmas Giant’s Tour! This massively fun competitive fishing event calls for some gigantically powerful angling tackle, and the CGT BBgun™ is just that! Being a top-level casting reel, it features all the top-notch technological advancements today’s reel-building has to offer! Flawlessly designed and decorated in the CGT theme style, the BBgun™ is a true Tournament edition collectible that boast unmatched power, titanic casting potential, sleek precision and ultra drag power to give you maximum fighting potential when going after gigantic Trophies of the deep!

gear.name: RIVERTEX™ SnowQueen™
gear.description: Looks like Christmas didn’t come alone this year, bringing you the SnowQueen™ casting reel to boost up your holiday spirits with an outright royal performance! Decorated with cool snowflake designs to match the holiday magic, this unique collectible angling tool offers smooth and powerful performance within a lightweight and durable aluminum alloy frame body! With full corrosion and water resistance, the SnowQueen™ is just the wonder-woman to support you in all your winter fishing escapades!

gear.name: RIVERTEX™ FPBS Firenado™
gear.description: You are holding a real fiery storm! This new multiplier reel from the RIVERTEX premium range is equipped with a substantial spool made of durable and light moldable alloy ArtSpool™ with a reliable EasyDrag™ drag system and ABS StraighLine Duo™ anti-slip technology. This tool offers an unlimited potential of extremely accurate casts and excellent control. TCBearings™ tungsten bearings allow for precision worthy of Swiss watches. The motto of this flaming beast reads power and reliability! Take it with you and set off to land the most aggressive fish in your pond.

gear.name: FireCannon™
gear.description: FireCannon™ is a limited 4th of July Edition casting reel with a cool collectible design in the shape of a cannonball, that was created to honor yet another anniversary of America’s triumph and freedom! But aside from its utterly unique appearance, the FireCannon™ casting reel brings you a truly awesome combo of lightweight design and hi-end technologies, making it a super powerful high-quality angling weapon that is sure to help you shoot far and land some of your best catches this Independence Day!

gear.name: RIVERTEX™ CamoCast™ Available only for The Fisherman Fishing Planet
gear.description: RIVERTEX™ CamoCast™ Available only for The Fisherman Fishing Planet

gear.name: RIVERTEX™ TriumphCast™ Available only for The Fisherman Fishing Planet
gear.description: RIVERTEX™ TriumphCast™ Available only for The Fisherman Fishing Planet

gear.name: MagFin™ HornReel™
gear.description: The reliable low-profile cast reel HornReel™ will help you drag out any large catch with no complications! Among its main advantages are durability and cast control system. The reel will guarantee confident retrieves and reliable hooksets, even with a truly feisty fish on the hook.

gear.name: RIVERTEX™ GoldenHarp
gear.description: The buzzing of this reel while going after fish sounds like music! This compact yet powerful little reel features StraightLine Duo® Cast anti-slip technology for incredibly precise casts and absolute control. All parts of the coil mechanism are perfectly matched, which makes it look like a well-tuned musical instrument. It’s waiting for you to just touch the strings!

gear.name: RIVERTEX™ WBT Maelstrom
gear.description: When creating the WBT Maelstrom 4000 reel specifically for the World Bass Tour, the RIVERTEX experts may have surpassed themselves. Built with the finest materials and the latest technologies, this powerful, durable reel features an impressive speed. In addition, it boasts a reliable centrifugal brake and quality line lay that helps avoid tangles. You can be sure that with this reel, landing large fish won’t be a problem!

gear.name: MagFin™ WBT DragAssistant
gear.description: Engineers at MagFin have worked hard to deliver this exclusive WBT DragAssistant 3500 S reel specifically for the World Bass Tour! It combines a lightweight, durable body made with latest standards in mind, a light spool, high winding speed, and a double magnetic-centrifugal drag system. At the same time, its eye-catching modern design, made in the tournament style, will undoubtedly set you apart from other anglers. All this makes this reel an ideal tool for a serious tournament fight — and practically a work of art!

gear.name: FishSpine
gear.description: You see it from the first glance: this reel is charged with magic. Ancient runes on its body bestow strength and power; a spool made from a huge fish vertebrae gives perfect winding speed; the handle has the bones of defeated monster fish fused into it: everything here is a good luck charm for you. Combined with the FishskullCast™ 220, this artifact reel is the perfect reward for slaying monsters!

gear.name: RIVERTEX™ TWKC TyphoonPro
gear.description: Developed for the Topwater Kayak Cup by Rivertex™, this reel is light and sturdy thanks to an ArtSpool® light alloy frame. Its power and high winding speed is achieved thanks to a unique tungsten carbide spool. The Straight Line Duo® Anti Backlash technology ensures accurate line lay, while the EasyDrag™ system allows you to tackle even the extra large and strong fish. Add a futuristic design and a scratch-resistant surface — and you've got yourself a perfect reel!

gear.name: MagFin™ X-Series Speedster
gear.description: Renowned fishing gear manufacturer MagFin™ is proud to present this impressive reel for tournament champions, perfect for catching really big fish! This reel has a reliable core, a lightweight but strong spool, and its magnetic and centrifugal brakes can reduce line tangling when casting. Don’t forget the impressive winding speed and elegant design — can this reel get even more incredible?

And for the ultimately powerful angling weapon, RedFish™ spinning reels can be perfectly combined with the super powerful Salmonster™ spinning rods for just the perfect combo to handle any huge red monster on a Tournament level!

gear.name: MagFin™ Ghost Reel™
gear.description: Celebrate All Saints' Eve with the limited Halloween edition Ghost Reel™! Flawless in performance, this superb rear drag spinning reel features unmatched casting precision and is perfect for making those long-distance casts when fishing for Halloween Monster Gars. Not to mention that the Ghost Reel’s™ cool and ghoulish design stylishly gets you into that Halloween spirited mood!

gear.name: MagFin™ WPT NorthernLite
gear.description: MagFin™ presents a truly exclusive fishing tool - the limited Tournament edition spinning reel to match the occasion of Winter Pike Tour - the ultimate Pike fishing competitive event of this winter! Not only this high-performance angling tool a genuine collectible, but it also features next-generation MicroLite® frame material that is super light, durable and completely corrosion resistant along with a unique gear system and ultralight spool for unmatched Tournament-level precision and superb casting control.

gear.name: RIVERTEX™ WTP MuskieSpin®
gear.description: This limited edition ultra powerful spinning reel was designed by Rivertex™ exclusively for the Winter Pike Tour - this winter’s ultimate competitive fishing event! Stylishly branded in WPT theme colors, this Tournament level spinning reel features a unique graphene body alloy, that is capable of withstanding substantially more pressure and torque than any graphite frame. Exceptionally strong and powerful, the WTP MuskieSpin® champion reel will stand for unprecedented durability and Tournament-level casting performance!

gear.name: MagFin™ HeartSpinner™
gear.description: This heartwarming limited edition spinning reel was designed by MagFin™ exclusively for the Crappie Valentine Cup - this Valentine’s Day competitive fishing event! Stylishly branded Tournament’s theme colors, this unique spinning reel is meant to be a true collectible with nonetheless great casting power and champion fishing potential! Exceptionally strong and powerful, the HeartSpinner 2500® is a super durable reel with Tournament-level casting performance!

gear.name: MagFin™ SCT Pouncer™
gear.description: The SCT Pouncer™ is a collectible limited edition spinning reel brought to you by MagFin™ to mark the occasion of Spring Cats Tour - this spring’s first and most exciting competitive fishing event! Exclusively branded in the Tournament’s theme colors, this unique spinning reel is meant to be a true collectible with champion casting potential! Exceptionally strong and powerful, the SCT Pouncer™ is the ultimate catfishing reel with Tournament-level casting performance!

gear.name: RIVERTEX™ CCO OmniVolt™
gear.description: The CCO OmniVolt™ is a collectible limited edition spinning reel brought to you by RIVERTEX™ to mark the occasion of Char Charger’s Open - one of the most exciting competitive fishing events this year! Exclusively branded in the Tournament’s theme colors, this unique spinning reel is meant to be a real gem with Tournament-level casting potential! Exceptionally strong and powerful, the CCO OmniVolt™ will help you demonstrate a truly supercharged angling performance!

gear.name: RIVERTEX™ CCO FireBall™
gear.description: CCO FireBall™ is a new truly exclusive fishing tool designed RIVERTEX™ within the framework of Char Charger’s Open tournament. Combining the power and casting potential of some of the brand’s best spinning reels, this limited Tournament edition piece features a stylish unique design to mark the occasion of this spring season’s final competitive event! This truly high-performance angling tool boasts unmatched Tournament-level precision and casting control aside from being a genuine collectible!

gear.name: UL-CHUBER™ MCT CarpAxel™
gear.description: If you are a lucky owner of this exclusive MCT edition carp reel by UL-CHUBER™, you can be sure that your carp fishing performance will be at its maximum! This is especially handy when competing in this September’s bottom fishing cyber tournament - Mighty Carp Tour! As any carp angler knows, these fish are a trick to catch and the right combo of MCT CarpAxel™ reel with the non less amazing MCT McCarp™ rod just might do the magic! After all, this high-performance spinning reel is an ultra-powerful and extremely durable collection edition fishing tool, designed in the Carp tournament’s color theme to ensure maximum efficiency when going after these clever critters.

gear.name: RIVERTEX™ GGC Gars'n'GloReel™
gear.description: Catching monstrous Gars is no easy task, but this Tounament-level spinning reel nails it superbly! Designed by top engineers at RIVERTEX™ exclusively for the Gars&Glory Cup tournament, the GGC GloReel™ is flawless in performance. Featuring limitless Champion potential and casting precision, this exclusive spinning reel is perfect for making those long-distance casts when fishing for trophy Gars. Not to mention the unique collectible design to match the theme and colors of GGC tournament!

gear.name: RIVERTEX™ CGT SpinTitan™
gear.description: The CGT SpinTitan™ is one big mean spinning reel! Brought to you by RIVERTEX™ this holiday season in the wake of Christmas Giant’s Tour, this limited edition spinning reel is a genuine GCT collectible relic! Exclusively branded in the Tournament’s theme and style, this powerful fishing tool is far from being just a pretty piece of tackle! You have to try it to believe the power and casting capacity of this big league monster catching spinning reel with Tournament-level performance capabilities! Exceptionally strong and powerful, the CGT SpinTitan™ is just the perfect choice for landing those trophies and uniques on the way to becoming Christmas Giant's Champion.

Outstanding controls and simply wonderful casting potential along with durable and corrosion-resistant aluminum alloy frame and spool make this unique collectible angling tool just the perfect companion for all you Christmas fishing getaways. gear.name: MagFin™ Hydra™
gear.description: Behold the new collectible edition spinning reel from our exclusive Golden Dragon Pack with a unique cool dragon design to die for! One of the most versatile reels, Hydra™boasts unmatched casting precision and premium performance for unmatched smoothness and supreme efficiency that’s worthy of the Dragon clan!

gear.description: This super powerful spinning reel from our exclusive edition Golden Dragon Pack, is a perfect and delightfully muscular heavy fishing allrounder with a killer casting potential to match the legendary enigmatic creature it embodies!

gear.description: BFFT BreamHunter™ is a superbly balanced lightweight feeder reel that was created exclusively for the Bream Feeder Frenzy Tour! Compact in size, the BFFT BreamHunter™ reel is equipped with a durable low-profile spool and perfectly suited for light feeder rods when bottom fishing at close range with light and medium weight feeders. An outstanding combination of quality and strength, this reel features cool collectible BFFT design!

gear.name: Flaggmann™ BFFT FrenzyForce™
gear.description: BFFT FrenzyForce™ is a limited Tournament edition feeder reel, designed exclusively for the Bream Feeder Frenzy Tour! Powerful and versatile, this large feeder reel features the deep spool option, suited for optimal performance when it comes to accurate casting. Reliable and strong enough to successfully handle a weighty catch, this reel combines hard-wearing durable components and the awesome exclusive BFFT design that makes it a genuine collectible worthy of true feeder fishing champions!

gear.name: RIVERTEX™ FPBS FireThunderSpin™
gear.description: FireThunderSpin™ is a new extra powerful reel by RIVERTEX. Indeed, its power is fire and thunder combined! It’s very light and ergonomic thanks to new technologies. Its sturdy core is reinforced with the TCP® fine finish in diamond polishing: this tool will serve you for a long time, enlarging your trophy list with especially large fish. Pair this reel with the new spinning rod FireZeus™, and behold the superpower in your hands ready to catch the scariest water monsters.
