gear.name: UL-CHUBER™ SuccadeReel™
gear.description: SuccadeReel™ embodies many ingenious technical solutions. Its short low-profile cone-shaped spool allows this swift beauty to make distant casts, while the oscillation system TelePort™ provides perfect line lay. This sturdy reel with a wonderfully balanced rotor will make your Christmas fishing experience truly enjoyable.

gear.name: MagFin™ ChocoBoom™
gear.description: The compact spinning reel ChocoBoom™ has caused quite a stir in the angler community! It’s a perfect match to the rod ChocolateBar™, and they truly make a dream team with the light spinning rod. Despite the small size of the reel, it is incredibly powerful.

gear.name: MagFin™ LuckyReel
gear.description: To catch a Snakehead, you’ll need a bit of luck — and a Lucky Reel! This super powerful spinning reel dances as if in an Irish reel dance and helps you get out your catch in the blink of an eye. The rear drag allows you to fine-tune the settings and makes it easier to land the Snakeheads.

gear.name: UL-CHUBER™ WCC Ambusher™
gear.description: This perfectly balanced feeder reel by UL-CHUBER™, designed specifically for the World Cats Cup, is sure to become an indispensable aid for every bottom fishing tournament participant! This powerful and extremely reliable spinning reel with an extra deep spool will allow you to take on even very large tournament fish. With this reel, the most valuable trophies will surely be yours!

gear.name: UL-CHUBER™ WCC Torbellino™
gear.description: This limited edition feeder reel by UL-CHUBER™ was created specifically for the World Cats Cup. This powerful and very fast spinning reel with high capacity high-tech spool and lightweight graphite rotor is ideal for catching heavy bottom-dwelling fish. The waterproof front drag system, impressive durability, and ease of use will allow you to fully concentrate on winning.

gear.name: Ossibus
gear.description: To resist the evil spirits that broke into our world on Halloween, you need the best equipment. The Ossibus Green 8500 reel matches the Femur 385 rod perfectly. Celtic oak, ancient bones, and the magical power of runes make it an excellent tool in the fight against otherworldly monsters!

gear.name: RIVERTEX™ TWKC Supperior™
gear.description: Designed exclusively for the Topwater Kayak Cup, this extremely powerful and durable reel from Rivertex™ is packed with new technologies! The strong and surprisingly light ARTEX Slim™ body houses an extra-large spool with a unique TCP™ diamond polish finishing. The StraighLine™ system prevents any spool play, and the unique HydroStop™ technology will protect the bearings from moisture, which will allow you to fish freely in any weather!

gear.name: UL-CHUBER™ X-Series TornadoMax
gear.description: This is one of the best bottom reels UL-CHUBER™ has ever created for tournament winners! It combines elegance of design with impressive power and winding speed. Lightweight high-tech spool in a durable aluminum frame, reliable draw handle, balanced graphite rotor, perfect line lay that prevents tangling, waterproof drag with AquaStop™ technology — what else can an angler ask for?

gear.name: MagFin™ X-Series HeavyStar
gear.description: This MagFin™ reel for tournament champions is perfect for all types of heavy lure casting. Its balanced rotor, shortened narrow profile spool that eliminates any backlash, an advanced line laying system, and a waterproof drag system make this reel extra effective for catching even very large fish. Its strong core and additional protective elements will provide durability, reliability, and convenience in use.

gear.name: UL-CHUBER™ LBFC Jetstream
gear.description: A sleek yet incredibly powerful UL-CHUBER™ bottom reel custom designed for the Live Bait Fiesta Cup. The LBFC Jetstream 11000 is a lightweight, fast and strong reel with a graphite body. Its waterproof front friction brake constructed with AquaStop™ technology delivers flawless performance and is capable of handling loads of up to 32 kilograms. Isn't this the dream of every professional angler? Don’t forget about a comfortable handle, a smooth spool stroke, and no backlash — and you got yourself a perfect reel!

gear.name: RIVERTEX™ LBFC StreamRunnerPro
gear.description: Specifically for the Live Bait Fiesta Cup tournament, Rivertex™ has developed a heavy-duty LBFC StreamRunnerPro 5500 spinning reel, which turns landing especially large fish into an enjoyable pastime! The combination of a light body with a powerful spool, as well as the use of modern technologies for line laying, maximum accuracy, and casting control, make this reel the ultimate assistant in hunting big and hardy fish. It has a huge margin of safety and bearings protection against moisture ingress, made using proprietary HydroStop™ technology, which guarantees successful fishing in any weather and victory!

gear.name: Savanna Spirit
gear.description: Savanna Spirit™ spinning reel unveils the ancient power of the African savannah this Halloween! Designed for precise control and maximum durability, Savanna Spirit™ pairs perfectly with the Tribal Totem™ rod. Its smooth casting and powerful drag system ensure that no monster, no matter how strong, will escape. With its bold tribal design and flawless performance, Savanna Spirit™ immerses you in the primal energy of the savannah, empowering you to conquer dark waters and triumph in your Halloween adventure!

gear.name: Nordic Beast
gear.description: Unleash your inner warrior this Halloween with the limited edition Nordic Beast™ spinning reel! Inspired by the fierce spirit of the Vikings, this reel combines strength and powerful performance, perfectly complementing the Wicked Viking™ rod. Adorned with Viking runes and dragon engravings, the Nordic Beast™ offers unmatched stability and control, making it ideal for conquering even the mightiest underwater foes. With this reel in hand, you’ll feel the raw power of the northern warriors as you face the stormy seas and reel in the monstrous Armored Bighead. Let the spirit of the Vikings guide you in this ultimate Halloween fishing adventure!

gear.name: Scarlet Thread
gear.description: Crafted for those who demand both power and accuracy, this reel strikes the perfect balance between speed and torque. The robust front drag system allows you to reel in your catch efficiently. This reel ensures ultra-smooth and comfortable operation even under heavy loads, making it versatile for various fishing scenarios. Designed to pair seamlessly with the Black Needle 230 spinning rod—just as a needle and thread go together—and to pay homage to traditional Ukrainian embroidery crafted with black and red threads.

gear.name: Tsurihito™ Tsunami Koiru
gear.description: This powerful spinning reel Tsunami Koiru, made by the leading manufacturer of fishing tackle, the Japanese company Tsurihito™, has a fairly large size but is easy to operate and doesn’t require special care. Being one of the most reliable reels in its class, it fully meets all the main requirements of a modern angler. A special boron nitride coating on the various 3D-BN® reel mechanisms guarantees exceptional strength, durability, and wear resistance.

gear.name: Tsurihito™ Tengu Kai
gear.description: This saltwater spin reel is designed for smooth, effortless retrievals under extreme strains. Its full metal body ensures strength and stability under heavy loads. The KaijutsuShield™ corrosion-resistant sealing protects internal components from saltwater and debris, guaranteeing long-term reliability. Additionally, Shinobi™ silent gear alignment minimizes noise and vibration for an ultra-smooth experience. Whether battling big fish offshore or enduring rough waters, this reel is built to perform.

gear.name: Fletch and Bradford™ BossCast
gear.description: Designed for versatility, these durable saltwater spin reels are perfect for long-distance casting and handling medium to large fish. The combination of TorqueFlow™ technology for smooth torque under heavy loads and HydroLock™ sealing for unmatched water resistance ensures flawless performance in all conditions. With a lightweight construction and advanced balance provided by FaBalancePro™, these reels offer reliability, comfort, and precision for extended fishing sessions.

gear.name: Fletch and Bradford™ XCurrent
gear.description: This saltwater spin reel delivers consistent power and smooth performance under extreme conditions. FaLight™ aerospace-grade aluminum construction keeps it lightweight yet durable, reducing fatigue on long trips. TorqueFlow™ precision-machined gears provide consistent torque, ensuring seamless power transfer when fighting fish. For ultimate protection, HydroLock™ triple-layer sealing safeguards internal components from salt, water, and debris, extending the reel’s lifespan.

gear.name: Tsurihito™ JigokuTen
gear.description: JigokuTen™ saltwater spin reel combines durability and precision. Its lightweight construction ensures easy handling, making it ideal for long fishing sessions. Designed for small to medium-sized fish, it features RyuGear™ multi-layered steel gears for smooth power transfer and KaijutsuShield™ triple-layer corrosion protection to withstand tough marine environments. JigokuTen™ is a perfect mix of durability and sensitivity for jigging.

gear.name: Fletch and Bradford™ TitanGolda LWR
gear.description: The well-known American company Fletch and Bradford™ (FaB) introduces the new TitanPro Golda LWR reel for beginner anglers, which can be used for trolling small marine fish. Equipped with a line-layer and a spool release switch, it is a fairly powerful and affordable reel. The FaBula® technology guarantees high-quality protection against the aggressive effects of seawater. The StopWet® moisture-proof insulating gasket, AntiRust® anti-corrosion bearings, as well as the additional FullCover® protection of gears and mechanisms from dust, sand, and salt, ensure the trouble-free service of this reel!

gear.name: Fletch and Bradford™ FlowCatch
gear.description: The American company Fletch and Bradford™ (FaB) has manufactured this FlowCatch saltwater baiting reel specifically for anglers for whom reliability is the main requirement in saltwater fishing. It possesses huge free-floating spool capacity, AntiRust® protected instantaneous anti-reverse brake bearing, StopWet® waterproof gasket, and other benefits of FaBula® protection technology. The lightness and strength of the body combined with the power and smoothness in reeling in the largest marine dwellers puts it ahead of any other reels of this class!

gear.name: Fletch and Bradford™ AtlantisElite
gear.description: The Atlantis Elite marine multiplier trolling reel from the well-known Fletch and Bradford™ (FaB) company without line-layer and spool release button has one handle, a large spool capacity, a drag adjustment lever, and a speed switch. This reel can withstand heavy load and deliver maximum stopping power, as well as smooth and even DoubleTooth® drag that lasts throughout the fight. The steel-carbon brake system is highly reliable, has a long service life, is not afraid of overheating and is fully protected thanks to FaBula® technology. This firmly places this reel in the category of premium gear.

gear.name: Fletch and Bradford™ AquaTrekker
gear.description: The AquaTrekker reel from the well-known sea fishing tackle manufacturer Fletch and Bradford™ (FaB) is of interest not only for sea trolling experts, but also for beginner anglers. The reel has a line-layer and is designed for catching medium-sized marine fish. The FaBallance® technology perfectly balances the rotor, completely eliminating its vibrations, which in turn ensures speed, winding quality, and ease of use. A high-quality waterproof and anti-corrosion coating provides this reel with strength and durability.

gear.name: Tsurihito™ TsuruOcean LP
gear.description: The TsuruOcean LP from the Japanese company Tsurihito™ is a low profile saltwater baitcasting reel that you can trust 100%. This reel easily and smoothly overcomes the resistance of heavy loads, which allows you to cast both weightless plastic lures and heavy ones with accuracy, and also increases the casting distance with less effort. The spool, rotor and parts of the drag mechanisms of the reel, made using the innovative TatsumakiLite® technology from an ultra-light and strong alloy, are wear-resistant and provide high-speed winding. It has a waterproof body that is resistant to the aggressive marine environment.

Bread
gear.description: Bread is one of the most popular and simple fishing baits used in angling. In fact, of all the possible baits in the arsenal of today’s angler, bread is probably the oldest and yet the most effective trick. It is used in fishing both as hook bait and as a groundbait. If used the right way, bread can be the kind of bait that is second to none.

gear.name: Cheese
gear.description: Cheese is a well know bait among anglers. Using cheese as fishing bait is fairly simple. Although it doesn’t matter which type of cheese you use, since the fish aren’t exactly picky when it comes to dairy products, strong smelling cheeses (like Danish Blue or Blue Stilton) are more preferable.

gear.name: Corn
gear.description: Corn is one of the most effective and cheapest freshwater bait. This bait is so versatile that it's at home for catching various species from trout to sunfish. It is also a bait that will entice big fish, so if you are being pestered by minnows but know that bigger fish is there, then corn could be the answer.

gear.name: Dough Ball
gear.description: Dough Ball fish bait is simple to make and can attract a variety of freshwater fish species. Everyone can prepare this excellent old-school bait. The only thing you need is a bit of flour and a cup of water. Easy to prepare, dough balls may be made ahead of time and kept in a zippered plastic bag in the refrigerator for a week or more.

gear.name: Marshmallow
gear.description: Marshmallow have long been a secret weapon for fishermen. Almost all freshwater fish will strike on this uncommon bait. However, because they have a relatively high air content, marshmallows have the tendency to float.

gear.name: Peas
gear.description: Peas is one of the best baits for Carp. It is high in protein and fiber and this is what carp and other big fish like most about this bait.

gear.name: Pet Food
gear.description: Pet Food Many anglers use canned dog and cat food to chum baitfish, but it’s also a good bait for various fish species. This bait is the most effective for bottom-feeding fish.

gear.name: Semolina Balls
gear.description: Semolina Balls is a popular fishing bait. Like dough balls, it is a good natural meal for almost all freshwater fish. Under certain conditions, semolina balls could be much more effective than ordinary dough balls.

gear.name: Pearl Barley
gear.description: Pearl Barley A traditional bait used by anglers since days of old. And for all the good reasons too! This effective alternative to more expensive baits is simply adored by Roach, Crucian Carp, Common Rudd and many other fish.

gear.name: Bread with Honey
gear.description: Bread with Honey Simple and easy to prepare, this delicious sticky paste made out brown bread and honey will do wonders when used as bait for going after most coarse fish species.

gear.name: Sweet corn
gear.description: Sweet corn is of the best baits for going after all species of Carp. It is also easy for fish to spot thanks to its bright yellow color.

gear.name: Sweet Peas
gear.description: Sweet Peas Another popular vegetal alternative to sweet corn, sweet peas are great bait for feeder fishing, particularly when going after fish like all Carp species and large Common Bream.

gear.name: Vegetables
gear.description: Vegetables A simple and effective bait that will work great for feeder fishing, particularly when aiming to catch fish like Silver Carp or Bighead Carp.

gear.name: Pea dough
gear.description: Pea dough Made out of peas and semolina, this pea dough is the most versatile bait for feeder fishing, that will do wonders for attracting Crucian Carp, Bream, European Carp, large Roach and practically all coarse fish species.

gear.name: Camu-Camu
gear.description: Camu-Camu . The extremely sour taste of this fruit does not please the human palate, but the fresh camu-camu is used as great bait for fishing.

gear.name: Rubber Tree Seeds
gear.description: Rubber Tree Seeds These seeds come from rubber trees (Hevea brasiliensis), each one looks like a large seedpod with three egg-shaped kernels inside a hard shell. This is a truly gourmet item for local fish!

gear.name: Jauari Palm Fruit
gear.description: Jauari Palm Fruit (Astrocaryum jauari) have juicy flesh and a large stone seed inside. This delicious treat is especially favored by frugivorous fish.

gear.name: Moriche Palm Fruit
gear.description: Moriche Palm Fruit Local crafters make juice, jam and even wine out of moriche palm fruit. But we are mainly interested in its abilities to attract herbivorous fish. They love this sweet dessert and can sense it from far under the water.

gear.name: Banana bread
gear.description: Banana bread pellets make an excellent bait for most African non-predatory fish. This treat is especially favored by the Banded Tilapia and Nile Tilapia.

gear.name: Oat-flakes
gear.description: Oat-flakes Some simply steam oatmeal, and some make a thick porridge. However you cook it, most non-predatory fish won’t resist such a bait!

gear.name: Curd Dough
gear.description: Curd Dough A thick plastic substance made from cottage cheese, honey, flour, or bread, and cooked on fire, can be used as bait for many non-predatory fish.

gear.name: Bloodworms
gear.description: Bloodworms are sometimes called the “ultimate fish bait." They are extremely effective as bait and play a vital role in the natural diet of numerous fish species, particularly due to their high protein content. This makes bloodworms exceptionally attractive for many fish species.

gear.name: Crickets
gear.description: Crickets make great bait for catching a variety of fish including bass, trout, and all kinds of pan-fish such as bluegill. Crickets can sometimes attract fish that other types of baits cannot. Probably the most effective overall bait for bluegills and trout.

gear.name: Dragonfly
gear.description: Dragonfly have been used by anglers as bait for years being an excellent bait for many top-water species, such as bass, trout and salmon.

gear.name: Flies
gear.description: Flies get blown into the water, during summertime, and fish are often found near the bank waiting for them. If you have a net you can round up plenty of flies for bait. The advantage of using flies is that they work well both dead or alive.

gear.name: Grasshoppers
gear.description: Grasshoppers are an easy live bait to work with due to their large size and being relatively easy to catch. Using grasshoppers as live fishing bait takes practice and some trial and error to learn the techniques that work for different fish and fishing spots.

gear.name: Leeches
gear.description: Leeches are an excellent live freshwater bait for walleye, catfish and northern pike. What is more, if you are looking for the perfect catfish bait then look no further. Leeches can be found in various types of lakes, farm ponds and streams.

gear.name: Maggots
gear.description: Maggots are a perfect coarse bait, arguably the best bait to ensure a catch even on the worst of fishing days. By throwing free offerings of maggots (feeding) into the water around a baited hook, fish are attracted to the area, which substantially increases the chance of success. Great bait for a whole variety of fish.

gear.name: MayFlies
gear.description: MayFlies are used by anglers for years, being known as the number one most popular and effective trout bait in the world.

gear.name: Night Crawler
gear.description: Night Crawler , the reddish-gray-colored common earthworm, is familiar to anyone with a fishing rod or a garden. They are indigenous to Europe, but are now abundant in North America and Western Asia.

gear.name: Red Worms
gear.description: Red Worms are known under various common names such as brandling worms, panfish worms, trout worms, tiger worms or red wiggler worms. The red worms is one of the traditional baits that have been used for hundreds of years.

gear.name: Wax Worms
gear.description: Wax Worms are the answer if you are looking for effective panfish bait. They are the bait of choice to fill your stringer in no time. Also are known to be the best grub-bait and are particularly effective for trout fishing.

gear.name: Pinkies
gear.description: Pinkies . A smaller version of an all-time favorite maggot bait, pinkies are the larva of the common green bottle fly. Works as great fishing bait, particularly when going after fish like Roach, Blue Bream, Silver Bream and White-eye Bream.

gear.name: Caster Maggots
gear.description: Caster Maggots . A great bait for coarse fishing, casters are the stages in the growth of a maggot that already contains the soon-to-emerge fly. Slightly smaller and more rounded in shape than maggots, casters work as great feeder bait for many fish species.

gear.name: Yellow Maggots
gear.description: Yellow Maggots . Lively and fresh, these yellow maggots are a popular choice for bottom fishing among coarse anglers and will work particularly great bait when going after fish like Bream and many other species.

gear.name: Red Maggots
gear.description: Red Maggots . Plump, juicy, fresh and bright red in color, these red maggots are great bait for coarse fishing. Particularly effective when going after large Bream and smaller Roach.

gear.name: Mole Cricket Larva
gear.description: Mole Cricket Larva . Fresh and supple, this larvae of the mole crickets is an extremely effective bait that is an irresistible yummy treat for Catfish and European Chub.

gear.name: Centipedes
gear.description: Centipedes . Centipedes are a versatile alternative to most other insect baits that will work great for catching practically all coarse fish species.

gear.name: Cockchafer
gear.description: Cockchafer . An all-time favorite among anglers, cockchafers are a marvelous insect bait for catching fish like European Chub and Asp.

gear.name: Dobsonfly Larva
gear.description: Dobsonfly Larva . Dobsonflies are the largest known flying insects. Their larvae are so big that they are part of the diet of some Amazon indigenous peoples. And fish just go crazy over dobsonflies!

gear.name: Dobsonfly
gear.description: Dobsonfly An impressive giant of a fly, this insect does a great job of attracting local fish, who consider it a delicious treat!

gear.name: Blue-Winged Grasshopper
gear.description: The Blue-Winged Grasshopper is so huge that many mistake it for a locust. Its bright wings are great at attracting surface-dwelling fish, such as Apapa. At the same time it’s weighty enough to be used for distance casts.

gear.name: Giant Silk Moth Larva
gear.description: Giant Silk Moth Larva . This is a larva of a giant silk moth. It’s large, fleshy and bright, which makes it a delicacy of choice for the catfish and other omnivorous fish.

gear.name: Caddis Larva
gear.description: Caddis Larva is an excellent small bait for all nonpredatory bottom-feeding fish. It can be especially successful in attracting the Bulldog Fish, Elephant Fish, and smaller specimens of the African Big Eye Catfish and Congo Yellowfish.

gear.name: African Giant Water Bug
gear.description: African Giant Water Bug Try using this giant bug as a bait when pursuing African catfish species, and you’ll be impressed! This insect predator can reach over 10 cm in length, and smaller specimens of the African Sharptooth Catfish, Vundu Catfish, or Kamba Catfish simply can’t ignore it.

gear.name: Bark Beetle Larva
gear.description: Bark Beetle Larva This large and heavy curved larva is not only a woodpecker's favorite delicacy, but also an excellent bait for many fish. It can reach a length of 4 to 7 centimeters and is the best delicacy for those fish that feed near the surface of the water.

gear.name: Crawling Worm and Selective Crawling worm
gear.description: Crawling Worm and Selective Crawling worm Thanks to its high flexibility and considerable size, the crawling worm makes an ideal bait for catching large fish. It is effectively used together with different types of hooks, which significantly raises the chances of a successful catch. This bait performs especially well in muddy and overgrown waters, where Catfish dwell and feed.

gear.name: Mole Cricket and Selective Mole Cricket
gear.description: Mole Cricket and Selective Mole Cricket Mole cricket is an insect with a hard exoskeleton and juicy body. Its natural smell is effective at attracting predators. The mole cricket is considered one of the best baits for catching Catfish and other large fish.

gear.name: Artificial Salmon Eggs
gear.description: Artificial Salmon Eggs are made from soft plastic and with their realistic look, in some cases, can be even more effective than real Salmon/Trout Eggs.

gear.name: Blood
gear.description: Blood was, for long time, an undisclosed secret of real catfish anglers. This bait work very well on blue catfish or channel catfish, especially in waters with a current.

gear.name: Crawfish
gear.description: Crawfish rank among the best baits for fishing in small rivers and ponds. It works great for catching both Smallmouth and Largemouth Bass, especially in spring and summer. Not to mention that most species of catfish feed on crawfish as well.

gear.name: Crawfish Cuts
gear.description: Crawfish Cuts will spread a tasty scent in the water, attracting Smallmouth and Largemouth Bass, especially in warm days of spring or summer. Sunken deeper, could be an irresistible attraction for most species of catfish.

gear.name: Frogs
gear.description: Frogs and tadpoles are excellent bait for catching Largemouth Bass as well as Smallmouth Bass and Butterfly Peacock Bass. Toads are also great bait for catching catfish.

gear.name: Large Cutbait
gear.description: Large Cutbait - cut, sliced, or squashed from a natural baitfish - allows the release of organic juices into the water. A natural bait, immediately recognizable by catfish as food in a natural sense. These big slices of fish will attract monsters!

gear.name: Large Minnow
gear.description: Large Minnow was always use as one of the most effective baits for catching big predators. It's the perfect choice for catching multiple game fish like pike, bass or salmon. Just make sure to choose heavy tackle when you want to use them!

gear.name: Medium Cutbait
gear.description: Medium Cutbait is a small fillet from a large baitfish, a natural bait that releases organic juices into the water. Great for catfish and smaller species.

gear.name: Small Cutbait
gear.description: Small Cutbait resemble with the left-overs from big fish hunts. Small or medium-sized fish are crazy about them. Small pieces from a large baitfish makes great cutbaits for catfish and smaller panfish.

gear.name: Natural Eggs
gear.description: Natural Eggs are highly productive bait for trout and salmon. The effectiveness of a salmon egg depends on two things: the quality of the egg, and the egg cure. The popularity of this bait has always been quite high among trout and salmon anglers. In fact, so high that hook manufacturers went to the trouble of designing hooks specifically for use with salmon eggs.

gear.name: Shiners
gear.description: Shiners are regarding by many fishermen as one of the most effective bait. It's perfect choice for catching multiple game fish like pike, bass, salmon and trout.

gear.name: Small Minnows
gear.description: Small Minnows are regarded by many fishermen as one of the most effective baits. It's the perfect choice for catching bass, crappie, perch or pickerel.

gear.name: Spawn Sacks
gear.description: Spawn Sacks with Salmon or Trout eggs are one of the most effective baits for going after Salmon, Steelhead and Trout. In fact, spawning fish may sometimes ignore all other baits.

gear.name: Duck Mussel Meat
gear.description: Duck Mussel Meat . A traditionally popular bait among coarse anglers, duck mussels are molluscs that are an excellent choice for attracting fish like Tench, Carp and Catfish.

gear.name: Technoplankton
gear.description: Technoplankton . A special dry-pressed fishing bait made from natural ingredients, technoplankton is the ultimate choice for feeder fishing, particularly when going after Bighead Carp and Silver Carp.

gear.name: Aracu Minnow
gear.description: Aracu Minnow . This tiny fish is the favourite food among Amazon predators. Use Aracu Minnow to get best results when fishing for large predator species.

gear.name: Dead Lambari Fish
gear.description: Dead Lambari Fish . They say dead fish is of little use to anyone. They are wrong! It can still serve as a bait for larger fish.

gear.name: Meat Chunk
gear.description: Meat Chunk . Everybody knows that piranhas love raw meat. But don't be surprised when you see how many other jungle fish species would love to feast on this bait.

gear.name: Chicken Liver
gear.description: The smell of the raw Chicken Liver is so strong that it travels far even in the water. It should attract catfish and perhaps other carnivorous fish.

gear.name: Freshwater Prawns
gear.description: Freshwater Prawns . The small size of these freshwater prawns makes them the favourite food for large and especially for small fish of the Amazon basin.

gear.name: Huge Cutbait
gear.description: Huge Cutbait Cutbait is natural bait, just the kind catfish immediately recognize as food in its natural sense. Either cut, sliced, or squashed from a natural baitfish, cutbait releases organic juices into the water. This is an excellent lure for large predators!

gear.name: Large Liver
gear.description: Large Liver The smell of the raw liver is so strong that it travels far even in the water. It should attract catfish and perhaps other carnivorous fish.

gear.name: Freshwater Crab
gear.description: Freshwater Crab Local underwater predators are so tough, that no crab shell can stop them. A crab is a real delicacy for them, and they are ready to eat it alive. But when it’s started to smell, it becomes simply irresistible!

gear.name: Banded Aracu
gear.description: The Banded Aracu is a small fish inhabiting Amazonian waterways. It’s the favorite delicacy of large predators like the huge Peacock Bass.

gear.name: Amazonian Sardine
gear.description: If you want to attract small Amazonian predators like Jacunda or Biara, the Amazonian Sardine is your best choice! This tiny elongated fish makes its carnivorous siblings bite as never before.

gear.name: Buffalo Kidneys
gear.description: Buffalo Kidneys When truly big African catfish are at stake, bring out the heavy artillery! Buffalo Kidneys are great at attracting the largest specimens of the African Sharptooth Catfish, Vundu Catfish, or Kamba Catfish.

gear.name: Small Tilapia
gear.description: Small Tilapia The image of this small member of the Cichlid family can be found in Ancient Egyptian writings. What’s more, it makes a wonderful large bait for all predator fish, especially the Nile Perch and the Tigerfish.

gear.name: Canned Meat
gear.description: If African catfish species are your main target, be sure to grab some Canned Meat . Its characteristic smell does a great job attracting these fish from long distances away.

gear.name: Sideswimmers
gear.description: Sideswimmers These small shrimp-like crustaceans are about 1 cm in length. The Baikal sideswimmer is an excellent bait for many types of fish, especially Whitefish. Since it is the basis of the diet of the Omul, huge flocks of this fish are drawn to where the sideswimmers are gathered.

gear.name: Boiled Red Roe
gear.description: Boiled Red Roe Boiled red caviar makes an ideal bait for all medium-sized Salmon. Boiled caviar loses its characteristic taste, and starts looking like a whitish gelatin ball.

gear.name: Common Minnow
gear.description: Common Minnow This small schooling fish makes an excellent bait for most predatory fish. Its weight doesn’t exceed 20 grams, and its length is usually less than 20 centimeters.

gear.name: Salo and Salo Generalske
gear.description: Salo and Salo Generalske Salo, or salt-cured pork fat, is not only a Ukrainian traditional dish, but also a wonderful bait for carp fishing. Fat and thick when cut, it stays reliably on the hook and emits a smell that attracts Common and Grass Carps. This bait is most effective in warm weather, when the fat actively releases its aroma.

gear.name: Shrimps
gear.description: Shrimps are a hard to be ignored bait for almost any fish. Bass, Panfish, Trout or Catfish loves them.

gear.name: Clam Meat
gear.description: Clam Meat . A genuine delicacy that will leave no fish indifferent, clam meat comes from tiny shellfish that are even smaller than mussels and is a superb choice of saltwater bait!

gear.name: Mussel Meat
gear.description: Mussel Meat . Soft, juicy and fresh out of the Gulf of Mexico, this deliciously irresistible mussel meat is one of the best fish baits, particularly when going after saltwater monsters!

gear.name: Crab
gear.description: Crab . A gourmet dish for humans and fish alike, this crab is a deliciously irresistible bait that does wonders at attracting predators in salty and brackish waters!

gear.name: Sand Fleas
gear.description: Sand Fleas . These tiny crustaceans that like to burrow in the sand of coastal swash zones are a super versatile and effective bait for saltwater fishing!

gear.name: Sea Worms
gear.description: Sea Worms . Perhaps, the most versatile choice of saltwater bait, sea worms will work great for catching practically any fish.

gear.name: Gulf Shrimp
gear.description: Gulf Shrimp . A yummy treat for absolutely any fish species, this fresh and juicy critter straight from the waters of the Gulf of Mexico is larger than any ordinary shrimp and an excellent choice for bait when fishing in seawater.

gear.name: Scaled Sardines
gear.description: Scaled Sardines . These small herring-like fish, native to the Gulf of Mexico, are a perfect choice of bait when going after vicious predators, particularly in this saltwater region.

gear.name: Finger Mullets
gear.description: Finger Mullets . Predatory fish can go into feeding frenzy when they come across schools of delicious finger mullets. No wonder these small inhabitants of brackish water areas are such a popular bait for saltwater fishing!

gear.name: Japanese Spiny Lobster
gear.description: Japanese Spiny Lobster This small spiny lobster reaches up to 30 cm long and can be found in the Pacific Ocean near the coasts of Japan, Taiwan, China, and Korea. It’s a valuable commercial crustacean in Japan, while also making a perfect bait for the Giant Grouper.

gear.name: Japanese flying squid
gear.description: The Japanese flying squid got its name from its ability to jump out of the water and fly a short distance above the surface. This small squid is perfect for baiting Snappers, Bonitos, Mackerels, Marlins, and Tunas.

gear.name: Japanese Jack Mackerel
gear.description: Japanese Jack Mackerel . This is a relatively large forage fish. In sports fishing, it makes an excellent bait for all pelagic predatory fish such as Tunas, Marlins, Mackerels, Bonitos, Yellowtails, and Trevallies. The average size of the Japanese Jack Mackerel is 20–35 centimeters.

gear.name: Japanese Anchovy
gear.description: Japanese Anchovy . This small forage fish is popular in Japanese and Korean cuisine, as well as makes excellent bait for all predatory marine pelagic fish such as small Tunas, small Marlins, Mackerels, Bonitos, Yellowtails, and Trevallies.

gear.name: Gutted Fish
gear.description: Gutted Fish . A gutted carcass of a small mackerel fish. It’s believed that the smell of gutted fish attracts predators faster. Its head can be fitted on one or two large hooks to make an excellent bait for Groupers, Snappers, or Sharks.

gear.name: Medium Fish Strips
gear.description: Medium Fish Strips . A medium-sized piece of fish meat with skin, cut into a strip along the spine. It’s mounted on one hook so that the sharp point is free. This is an excellent bait for Snappers, Trevallies, Greater Amberjack, and Small Grouper.

gear.name: Large Fish Strips
gear.description: Large Fish Strips . A large piece of fish meat with skin, cut into a strip along the spine. It’s mounted on one hook so that the sharp point is free. This is an excellent bait for Snappers, Trevallies, Greater Amberjack, Groupers, and Sharks.

gear.name: Flying Fish
gear.description: Flying Fish . A relatively small fish, perfect for a livebait trolling rig when targeting small to medium pelagic species. Widely recognized as a favorite prey for Tuna, Mahi-Mahi, and Marlin.

gear.name: Large Flying Fish
gear.description: Large Flying Fish . An extra-large Flying Fish, offering a bigger meal for pelagic predators. Its size makes it an ideal choice for targeting large Tuna and Marlin. Perfect for a livebait trolling rig.

gear.name: Indian Ocean Squid
gear.description: Indian Ocean Squid . A relatively small squid, used for a livebait trolling rig, native to the Indian and western Pacific Oceans, typically found in shallow waters. As a highly versatile bait, it attracts a variety of large saltwater predators, including Tuna, Marlin, Wahoo, and Mahi-Mahi.

gear.name: Split Tail Mullet
gear.description: Split Tail Mullet . This middle-sized mullet is specially cut along its body to enhance its movement during trolling. The modified tail creates a natural fluttering action, making the bait appear more lifelike in the water. It's an excellent choice for trolling all pelagic fish with a livebait trolling rig.

gear.name: Fish Head
gear.description: Fish Head . This fresh tuna head slowly releases its natural oils into the water, making it an irresistible target for voracious saltwater predators. A solid pick for bottom fishing.

gear.name: Tuna Fish Heads
gear.description: Tuna Fish Heads . Chunky, bony tuna heads. The Butcher Shark loves crunching on a snack like this.

gear.name: Giant Tiger Prawn
gear.description: Giant Tiger Prawn . Found throughout the warm waters of the Indo-Pacific region, this large shrimp is easily recognized by its bold black stripes. Its impressive size and firm texture make it an incredibly versatile bait, attracting a wide range of saltwater fish.

gear.name: Indo-Pacific Swimming Crab
gear.description: Indo-Pacific Swimming Crab . A favorite snack for bottom predators, such as Groupers, Snappers, and Sickle Pomfret. Its natural appeal makes it a go-to bait for fishing near reefs and sandy shallows.

gear.name: Natal Rock Oyster Meat
gear.description: Natal Rock Oyster Meat . Growing on submerged rocks and harbor walls, this oyster is a favorite snack for many bottom fish. Its fresh meat makes it an effective and versatile bait.

gear.name: Filamentous Red Algae
gear.description: Filamentous Red Algae . Filamentous Red Algae is like an ocean salad bar for herbivorous fish! A Sleek Unicornfish especially can’t resist it.

gear.name: Luminous Flying Fish
gear.description: Luminous Flying Fish . Flying Fish are perfect as live bait for trolling smaller and mid-sized pelagic species, but the luminous ones are especially flattering for the legendary Night Windrazor. Their brilliance is so dazzling that it effortlessly attracts the attention of this rapid hunter.

gear.name: Atlantic Herring
gear.description: Atlantic Herring . Atlantic Herring is a large live bait fish and one of the most popular go-to choices in the North Atlantic. Its oily flesh provides rich nutrition, while the shiny scales reflect light underwater, mimicking the flash of a fleeing baitfish. Favored by top predators like Halibut, Atlantic Cod, Coalfish, Common Ling, Atlantic Salmon, and especially European Hake, it's a versatile option for saltwater fishing.

gear.name: Lesser Sand Eel
gear.description: Lesser Sand Eel . Lesser Sand Eel is a slender, wriggly live bait favored by many bottom-dwelling and mid-water saltwater predators. In the North Atlantic, few baits match its versatility for tempting small- to medium-sized predators such as Cod-like fish, Halibut, Trout and many others, especially around sandy bottoms where Sand Eels naturally gather.

gear.name: Atlantic Mackerel Сut Baits
gear.description: Atlantic Mackerel Сut Baits . Large, oily chunks of mackerel that hold up well on the hook thanks to their tough texture. Its high fat content creates a strong scent trail in the water, making it a top choice when targeting saltwater hunters like Flatfish, Norway Seaperch, and European Angler.

gear.name: Bluey
gear.description: Bluey . A whole bait fish without the head and tail, split along the backbone, and partly turned inside out before being tied with thread for a secure hold. Its rich scent and oils make it a fantastic choice for big bottom-dwelling fish like Halibut, Spiny Dogfish, European Sea Sturgeon, and others.

gear.name: Seal Blubber
gear.description: Seal Blubber . Thick chunks of seal fat, rich in oils and nutrients. As the scent slowly spreads through the water, it sends an irresistible signal to Greenland Sharks, driving them to seek out this calorie-packed meal. Ready to face a giant like this? Then seal blubber is the bait to choose!

gear.name: Ragworms
gear.description: Ragworms . Ragworms are common marine worms found across the North Atlantic. They live in shallow coastal areas with muddy or sandy-mud bottoms and are an excellent bait for any small- to medium-sized saltwater fish: from Atlantic Saury and Mackerel to Haddock and Whiting.

gear.name: Black Lugworms
gear.description: Black Lugworms . Large worms that can grow over 30 cm long and live on sandy beaches. Bigger and rarer than the common lugworms, they're considered the best of their kind for attracting saltwater predators, including European Sea Sturgeon and cod-family species such as Haddock and Cusk.

gear.name: Peeler Crab
gear.description: Peeler Crab . Fresh from shedding its shell, this soft-bodied crab is a tender, nutritious, and easy-to-digest treat for fish. It's usually cut into pieces and tied to the hook with thread to keep it secure, making it perfect for all Cod-like fish, Flatfish, Sturgeon, and especially Atlantic Wolffish.

gear.name: Razor Shell
gear.description: Razor Shell . Razor Shell is a long, narrow clam found in the sandy shallows of northern coasts. Its soft flesh is rich in scent and nutrients, making it highly attractive to a range of saltwater species such as Haddock, Whiting, Cusk, and Atlantic Wolffish.

gear.description: UL-CHUBER™ Sinking Boilies 1" (25 mm)

gear.description: UL-CHUBER™ Sinking Boilies 6" (15 mm)

gear.description: UL-CHUBER™ Sinking Boilies 1" (25 mm) Golden

gear.description: UL-CHUBER™ Pop-up Boilies 8" (20 mm)

gear.description: UL-CHUBER™ Pop-up Boilies 4" (10 mm)

gear.description: UL-CHUBER™ Pop-up Boilies 8" (20 mm) Golden

gear.description: UL-CHUBER™ Pop-up Pellets 6" (14 mm) Golden

gear.name: Candy
gear.description: Candy . Here, fishy fishy...Trick or treat! These Halloween pumpkin jellies are just the perfect bait to liven up that holiday spirit and awaken your inner child as you go on a night hunt after monstrous bony anomalies that find pumpkin Candy simply irresistible!

gear.name: Sour Bread
gear.description: Sour Bread . Ugh, this is the kind of pastry you don’t ever want to try! Nevertheless, it appears that Halloween monsters and ordinary fish alike seem to find this bait extremely attractive.

gear.name: Moldy Cheese
gear.description: Moldy Cheese . This is neither Dorblu, nor Gorgonzola, and most definitely not Roquefort! Just your ordinary cheese that got old and moldy over time. Looks disgusting, smells even worse. But will work great as bait for all fish, including Halloween monsters!

gear.name: Drunken Worm
gear.description: Drunken Worm . This party animal is one fun live bait to fish with. Apparently green in color from drinking too much green beer, this shamrock critter is wild and out of control but just with the right attitude for attracting the Leprechaun Fish!

gear.name: Bully Grasshopper
gear.description: The unique Bully Grasshopper is not only a unique collectible bait that is versatile and useful for catching numerous fish. This St.Patrick’s Day bug is an ultimately attractive treat for the feisty Rowdy Bass.

gear.name: Dried Locusts
gear.description: Dried Locusts . Looking at these creepy overgrown grasshoppers, you can only feel relieved that they are dead and dry. Let’s hope we never encounter these critters in their swarming phase. Nonetheless, awesome bait that works great for all fish, including Halloween monsters!

gear.name: Candy Wax Worms
gear.description: Candy Wax Worms . A special bait for a special fish! Only on Christmas, you can get special Christmas baits for decorated fish. This is the most effective bait for catching Decorated White Crappie.

gear.name: Marmalade Red Worms
gear.description: Marmalade Red Worms . A special bait for a special fish! Only on Christmas, you can get special Christmas baits for decorated fish. This is the most effective bait for catching Decorated Prussian Carp.

gear.name: Dead Mice
gear.description: Dead Mice . This limited-time Halloween bait is great for catching all Gars and Catfish. Not to mention that the spooky Monster Gars will find it delicious!

gear.name: Pig's Eye
gear.description: Pig's Eye . This freaky limited-time bait is a Halloween offer that's just perfect for catching all Gars and Catfish. Not to mention that the spooky Monster Gars will find it especially delicious!

gear.name: Rotten Minnows
gear.description: Rotten Minnows . This is a limited-time offer available only on Halloween. The most effective bait for catching all Gars and Catfish. But most importantly, it attracts those scary Halloween Gars like no other!

gear.name: Frozen Cutbait
gear.description: Frozen Cutbait . Cutbait is natural bait, one catfish immediately recognize as food in a natural sense. A small fillet from a large baitfish makes great cutbait for catfish and smaller species. This is the most effective bait for catching Decorated Channel Catfish.

gear.name: Frozen Shiners
gear.description: Frozen Shiners . Shiners are regarded by many fishermen as one of the most effective baits. It's the perfect choice for catching multiple game fish like pike, bass, salmon, trout and gar. This is the most effective bait for catching Decorated Longnose Gar.

gear.name: Frozen Minnows
gear.description: Frozen Minnows . Minnows are regarded by many fishermen as one of the most effective baits. It's the perfect choice for catching multiple game fish like pike, bass or gar. This is the most effective bait for catching Decorated Alligator Gar.

gear.name: Glazing crawfish
gear.description: These well-cut Glazing crawfish will spread the tasty scent in the water to attract fish. This is the most effective bait for catching Decorated White Sturgeon.

gear.name: Caramel Chunks
gear.description: Caramel Chunks . This special fishing bait is the ultimate choice for carp fishing, particularly when going after Bighead Carp and Silver Carp. This is the most effective bait for catching Decorated Silver Carp.

gear.name: Baby-Buffalo
gear.description: Baby-Buffalo . They say that the Snakehead eats everything. But something really drives it crazy, forcing to rush to the bait. This little buffalo is a big temptation for a clever predator.

gear.name: Baby-Catfish
gear.description: Baby-Catfish . We don't know why the Snakeheads react so much to a baby catfish. Maybe they can't resist its adorable whiskers. In any case, this is one of the best bait for hunting Snakehead.

gear.name: Clown Frog
gear.description: Clown Frog . In a muddy pond, not that much entertainment, you know. So, Snakehead just can not miss the fun performance of the Clown Frog. Choose it as bait and see how quickly Snakehead reacts at its orange bubbles!

gear.name: Skull Bait
gear.description: Skull Bait . This unique bait is made entirely out of fish heads! It took catching and beheading five American Shads to prepare this skullful treat, and the head-hungry Eldergar will find it irresistible!

gear.name: Zombie Bait
gear.description: Zombie Bait . Made of undigested dead bird hatchlings that were found in the intestines of large Gars, this is easily the most gruesome and horrific bait ever used for catching Cats. However, it is probably the only bait disgusting enough to match and catch the no less abominable Zombie Cat!

gear.name: Caviar Bait
gear.description: Caviar Bait . This special bait is made out of a variety of Salmon Eggs taken from every kind of Salmon caught in the Kaniq Creek. Using such an exquisite dish as bait is your only hope of catching every last Albino Blackfish - fierce little mutants that are endangering the local population of Salmon.

gear.name: Voodoo Shells
gear.description: Voodoo Shells . This special bait is made out of molluscs from the Shells found at the bottom of lake White Moose and is exactly what Native American shamans used to summon the Voodoo Fish hundreds of years ago. Perhaps without the proper spells and rituals these Voodoo Shells are devoid of any magical powers, but their distinctive smell should definitely be enough to lure the wise old monster from its underwater hideout.

gear.name: Bassy Bait
gear.description: Bassy Bait . This live bait made out of freshly caught Largemouth Bass is meant for catching the Terror Tarpon, who seems to have a particular taste for these fish. With the brutal monster ruthlessly killing off one Largemouth after another, making this bait out 5 small fish seemed like a reasonable sacrifice the sake of saving the entire Bass population!

gear.name: Brown Trout Eggs
gear.description: Brown Trout Eggs . Almost any fish would love to get a taste of a first-class bait like Brown Trout Eggs. However, this yummy treat is meant for one particularly large, genetically modified organism known as the Rainbow Outlaw. After all, this scaly fugitive is a picky eater and won’t settle for anything less!

gear.name: Frankenbait
gear.description: Frankenbait . Made out of a variety of fresh Pike meat, this unique first-grade cutbait looks like a gourmet dish from a restaurant...or a prop from a Frankenstein movie. However you see it, Frankebait would be a yummy treat for the pickiest underwater predator, particularly, the Pike-hungry vengeful Walleye, better known as the Pikeslasher!

gear.name: Ginger Cookies
gear.description: Each housewife has her own recipe for festive pastry. But there is one universal recipe – it’s the beloved Ginger Cookies ! As soon as they come out of the oven, neither human nor fish can resist their pull. You simply won’t rest until you have one.

gear.name: Buñuelos
gear.description: Incredible winter delicacy: tender, spongy, hot pumpkin doughnuts, here to warm your hearts and stir up interest in the fish, who are keen to get some Christmas warmth. Even the bearded Bandit Aracu is ready to put his mischievous manner aside and get a couple of Buñuelos for tea!

gear.name: Cookies with Milk
gear.description: Cookies with Milk . What an absolute delight: to dunk a cookie in milk and eat it before it melts! It’s not only people who love it, fish are crazy about it too! Especially the Dunce Crappie, who is ready to jump out of the water for this treat.

gear.name: Turdilli
gear.description: Turdilli . A family recipe from your beloved Italian grandma. Deep fried wine-soaked honey cookies! They melt both in your mouth and in your hands, so you better put one on the hook and cast the rod. This dessert attracts sweet-toothed fish, and the Foolish Goby won’t keep you waiting!

gear.name: Stollen
gear.description: Stollen . The traditional stollen is made a month before Christmas and is left to age, soaking in the decadent flavors of melted butter and candied peel. Even a tiny bite of this dessert is likely to attract a large fish! Maybe even a certain old Eel, who has managed to steal something from Santa himself...

gear.name: Candy Cane
gear.description: Candy Cane . It’s impossible to imagine a Christmas tree without this traditional sweet decoration! This stripy candy looks like a cane and a hook at the same time. It comes as no surprise that such a lure can attract fish of all shapes and sizes. Even the Crumbling Krampus Payara doesn’t mind tasting this festive delicious cane!

gear.name: Eel Doll Bait
gear.description: Eel Doll Bait . This unique bait is made from silicone to imitate live Eels! It's the only way to catch Cannibal Eel with no harm to the protected species!

gear.name: Drowned Mouse
gear.description: Drowned Mouse . This unique bait is made out of drowned mice collected in the lake. It's the best thing to use for catching the Black Whisker!

gear.name: Pickled Jauari Palm Fruit
gear.description: Pickled Jauari Palm Fruit If the juicy fruits of the Jauari palm are pickled according to grandma's recipe, you get an incredible beer snack and a wonderful bait for fruitarian fish like the Buzzman Tambaqui.

gear.name: Infernal Crab
gear.description: Infernal Crab Ancient druid knowledge says this special bait attracts spirits and demons from otherworldly reality that got into fish.

gear.name: Hell Frog
gear.description: Hell Frog Ancient druid knowledge says this special bait attracts spirits and demons from otherworldly reality that got into fish.

gear.description: Ghost Moth Ancient druid knowledge says this special bait attracts spirits and demons from otherworldly reality that got into fish.

gear.name: Clam Shells
gear.description: Clam Shells Ancient druid knowledge says this special bait attracts spirits and demons from otherworldly reality that got into fish.

gear.name: Golden Corn
gear.description: Gorgeous large kernels of Golden Corn are without a doubt the best fish bait. Most freshwater dwellers, from Trout to Sunfish, are partial to corn. Keep in mind that this simple bait is great for attracting big fish and will guarantee the angler a successful catch!

gear.name: Mutant Lobster
gear.description: Mutant Lobster is a unique bait that has undergone an amazing mutation turning it into a living kaleidoscope. The Mutant Lobster emits a bright shimmering light that can attract and mesmerize deep-sea monsters, making it the perfect bait for hunting Grouperzilla.

gear.name: Suttungr’s Mead
gear.description: Suttungr’s Mead . This special bait, made from secret ingredients, pressed and dried under pressure, like a mythical drink, provokes berserker rage in the Armored Bighead.

gear.name: Pig's heart
gear.description: Pig's heart . Truly disgusting! A raw, bloody pig organ is the perfect bait for the Slide-Rock Bolter, which can smell fresh meat from afar.

gear.name: Bloody Flies
gear.description: Bloody Flies . Legends say these flies appeared at the site of a great battle where rivers of blood flowed. They attract fish with their rich, bloody scent.

gear.name: Blood Dough Balls
gear.description: Blood Dough Balls . Kneaded with the blood of ancient rituals, these sticky balls emit the scent of pain and death, irresistible to the fiercest monster fish.

gear.name: Boiled Crawfish
gear.description: Boiled Crawfish . Boiled in a witch's cauldron, these crawfish have absorbed a dreadful scent that drives the Armored Bighead monster insane.

gear.name: Cursed Aracu Minnow
gear.description: Cursed Aracu Minnow . This cursed fish, caught in Colombia's acidic river, emits gloomy magic. Its faint glow attracts those who dwell in darkness.

gear.name: Poisonous Maggots
gear.description: Poisonous Maggots . These larvae emerged from the toxic soil of an ancient cemetery. Their sinister glow and poisonous juices attract the most dangerous creatures lurking in the depths.

gear.name: Dried_Fish_Heads
gear.description: Dried_Fish_Heads . It took five dried fish to create these treats, that no catfish or monster can resist!

gear.name: Rotten liver
gear.description: Rotten liver . An unbearable smell makes this bait unique in the angler’s arsenal. The Dingonek monster won't be able to resist the liver spoiled by larvae.

The vinyl-coated stainless steel cable provides high strength and durability. Despite all the advantages of fish stringer, it could damage fish. So, if you are going to release the fish at the end of your fishing trip, you should better take a Keepnet.

The close fitting design with long sleeves and broad padded shoulders will keep you warm aside from giving you additional storage capacity for your lines and tackle.

gear.name: Santa Jacket
gear.description: Our Christmas edition extra warm and cozy Santa Jacket is a perfect way to show off your sense of humor and show everyone who’s the King of the pond around here. An absolute must-have this holiday season! Hand-knit from 100% red Wool with white fluffy insets from genuine Furry Trout fur!

Branded in the Spring Cats Tour tournament colors, this collectible fishing jacket features a sleek and daring design that speaks for itself, distinguishing a true Catfishing Champion! Aside from its bold exterior, the jacket will provide additional storage for 15 pieces of terminal tackle and 2 lines, keeping you comfortable and fresh all day long! Garry Scott™

gear.name: CCO SpeedyVest™
gear.description: Garry Scott™ designed this unique Tournament edition fishing jacket so that you could be ready for angling endeavours without anything weighing you down. Heavy on style with exclusive color scheme of Char Charger’s Open, this ultra-light durable jacket features breathable water-resistant fabric that keeps the wind out while providing sufficient ventilation to keep you dry all day long! You’ll love the comfortable fit of CCO SpeedyVest™ fishing jacket with multiple pockets and zippered compartments that provide for extra tackle storage!

Looking cool and stylish in the GSC Buffer™ , you’ll feel ready for any fishing escapades whatever the weather may bring. Sleek and trendy, this limited fishing jacket in the colors of Grand Smallie’s Cup, is made of durable, breathable and water-resistant fabric that keeps the wind and cold out while providing sufficient ventilation to keep you dry and warm all day long! Featuring multiple pockets and zippered compartments that provide for extra tackle storage!

gear.name: Tsurihito™ Volans™ Fishing Yacht
gear.description: Tsurihito Volans is an exclusive fishing yacht designed for those who love fishing with a group of friends. Its capacity allows you to bring along three mates to enjoy a fishing experience together. With eight rod stands placed on four fishing points, Tsurihito Volans opens up endless possibilities: trolling, bottom fishing, or something else — this boat can meet any angler’s ambitions. The uniqueness of Tsurihito Volans also lies in its built-in fish storage. You can be sure of having a place to store your catch and the cozy company of your friends on board.

gear.name: Tsurihito™ Scutum™ Fishing Yacht
gear.description: Tsurihito Scutum embodies efficiency and practicality among fishing boats. It’s designed for three people and is equipped with six rod stands, which makes it possible to use a variety of fishing methods. Thoughtful design allows you to use its potential with utmost efficiency even with its seemingly small size, providing comfort and productivity for you and your friends. Tsurihito Scutum is a practical and safe choice for those who value optimal features and reliability. Other languages: English русский українська

gear.name: Rent Fishing Yacht
gear.description: Rent Fishing Yacht is designed for two people and is equipped with four rod stands, which makes it possible to use a variety of fishing methods. Thoughtful design allows you to use its potential with utmost efficiency even with its seemingly small size, providing comfort and productivity for you and your friends. Other languages: English русский українська

gear.name: Tsurihito™ Chamaeleon™ Fishing Yacht
gear.description: Tsurihito™ Chamaeleon™ Fishing Yacht

gear.name: Noomaa Kuda Adventure Yacht
gear.description: Noomaa Kuda Adventure Yacht is a compact fishing boat built for two anglers and equipped with four rod holders for versatile angling. Despite its size, it offers everything you need for a productive day on the water — comfort, efficiency, and all the essential instruments for your tropical adventure in the heart of the Indian Ocean. Other languages: English русский українська

gear.name: Valkyrie™ Fishing Boat
gear.description: Valkyrie™ is a powerful vessel built to cut through ice and withstand the harshest northern storms, delivering the true thrill of extreme game fishing. With four fishing spots, each equipped with three rod holders, you will have plenty of room to share the best experience with your buddies. Get unique photos from your fishing trips with a powerful on-board crane to hoist your biggest catches. In addition, Valkyrie™ comes with huge refrigerated storage that can fit saltwater beasts and keep them super fresh, raising both your XP and profit. Other languages: English русский українська

gear.name: Ingrid™ Fishing Boat
gear.description: Ingrid™ is a sturdy industrial-style fiskebåt, set up with space for two anglers and four rod holders. Reliable even in rough waters and capable of breaking through ice, it’s perfectly suited for the harsh and stormy Norwegian weather. Onboard, you'll find all the necessary devices to make your fjord fishing trips efficient and safe. Other languages: English русский українська

gear.name: MagFin™ GoldenAlbatros™ Adventure Kayak
gear.description: MagFin™ GoldenAlbatros™ Adventure Kayak

gear.name: Wooden Kayak
gear.description: Genius lies in simplicity, as proven by this little Amazon kayak, which has served as a watercraft for local tribes for thousands of years. This rather heavy and stiff boat is, however, unbelievably durable! The Wooden Kayak is a boat of choice for those who value reliability and safety on the water. It provides comfort and calm, it’s wearproof and able to withstand any conditions. Thinking about fishing, not about whether your boat remains stable: sounds like a plan!

gear.name: MagFin™ Neptune™ Adventure Kayak
gear.description: Neptune™ is the perfect explorer kayak from MagFin™ that will be an overall versatile angling companion. Providing satisfactory comfort levels and controllability, this vessel offers a stable and swift performance under any conditions! Named after the ancient Roman god of freshwater and sea, this kayak boasts a sleek blue finish to please the eye!

gear.name: MagFin™ Tritone™ Adventure Kayak
gear.description: Tritone™ adventure kayak from MagFin™ was designed for anglers who value comfort and stability above all. This kayak is easy to handle and offers good control, making it well suited for beginning boatmen eager to take their angling experience to deeper waters! This super comfortable kayak is perfect for a weekend out on the water, providing a restful and relaxing experience thanks to its delightful combination of performance and comfort.

gear.name: MagFin™ SilverGull™ Adventure Kayak
gear.description: A genuine silver lining in the complex art of boatfishing, the SilverGull™ kayak from MagFin™ offers comfort and performance to match its color! Sleek and fast, this silvery watercraft is both speedy and equally easy to control, making it a comfortable choice for the intermediate-skilled rowers who want to dominate on the water!

gear.name: MagFin™ StarRanger™ Trolling Kayak
gear.description: StarRanger™ is your ultimate fishing workhorse! This pedal-powered fishing kayak is designed for trolling, giving you full foot control over movement while keeping your hands free to focus entirely on the catch. Equipped with two rod holders and an Echo Sounder, it helps to increase your haul. On top of that, StarRanger™ never requires stamina recovery pauses, making your fishing unstoppable.

gear.name: MagFin™ RedFox Speedy Kayak
gear.description: Light and fast, the RedFox Speedy Kayak is an outstanding angling companion to outmaneuver any lake, river or creek. Sleek and sneaky by design, this may not be the sturdiest and most durable vessel, but the RedFox ensures a superb combination of quality, performance and stability to make you fast king of the current whatever the conditions may be!

gear.name: MagFin™ SunFish Comfy Kayak
gear.description: Easy to handle on and off the water, the SunFish Comfy Kayak is perfectly suited for beginners eager to take their angling experience a step further and explore new limits as well as those who appreciate maximum comfort in whatever they do! This super comfortable vessel will have you feeling rested and relaxed while providing a wonderful combination of performance and stability within delightfully compact size and design.

gear.name: MagFin™ BlueWhale Endura Kayak
gear.description: Wherever you angling adventures take you, the BlueWhale Endura Kayak is the one angling companion whose true grit you can really count on. Built with a backbone, BlueWhale’s philosophy is all about making haste slowly! Unmatched durability and stable performance of this somewhat heavy fishing vessel make up for where it lacks in speed and swiftness and will have you feeling safe and secure whatever the conditions may be! Taking is slowly, the no hassle BlueWhale Endura Kayak is tough indeed and built to last!

gear.name: MagFin™ Santa’s Sleigh Kayak
gear.description: Ho ho ho! Great for lakes and rivers, this fun kayak lifts up your spirits with unique collectible Christmas design, decorated to look like a real Santa's Sleigh! Built from high quality material that is durable, this kayak features large seating area with soft thigh pads for ultimate comfort and coziness on cold winter days, making Santa’s Sleigh the perfect kayaking companion to spend the holidays with if you’re planning to do some Christmas fishing!

gear.name: MagFin™ MagFin™ DottedShark™ Sports Kayak
gear.description: MagFin™ MagFin™ DottedShark™ Sports Kayak

gear.name: MagFin™ Elven Kayak
gear.description: This fantastic fairy-tale Elven kayak is a real work of art that you can actually take out for a Christmas fishing ride! Durable high-density materials and ergonomic construction provide enough comfort for stable paddling to make fishing on this Elven kayak truly enjoyable! But most importantly, this vessel’s unique collectible design is decorated by adorable Christmas elves, better known as Santa’s helpers, bringing you closer to the Christmas jingle-bells magic!

gear.name: MagFin™ MagFin™ RedRiverDragon™
gear.description: This collectible editions kayak is a fantastic angling companion whose speed, agility and power can outmaneuver any current! Part of our new Golden Dragon Pack, the RedRiverDragonkayak stands up to its name, letting you take your angling experience a step further and explore new limits with the Dragon power on your side!

gear.name: MagFin™ Monstrosity
gear.description: The curse of Fankenfish is broken and the vile monster is conquered! All thanks to you! This unique kayak bears the Head of the Frankenfish on it’s bow, as a horrendously magnificent decoration, a proud ornamenting sign of your heroic Triumph that will be remembered for ages to come!

gear.name: MagFin™ Golden Kayak™
gear.description: This magnificent top-quality kayak, with a fantastic smokey black&gold finish, was designed exclusively for the elite grade Golden FP Pack! Fast and super comfortable, this golden child of boatbuilding provides the skillful rower with great controls, superb maneuverability, and overall exceptional performance.

gear.name: MagFin™ X-SERIES™ Pro Kayak
gear.description: Behold the ultimate champion-level angling kayak, from the X-SERIES™ professional line! They say the best things money can’t buy - and that’s just the case with the limited edition X-SERIES™ Pro Kayak that can only be won by the champion of a kayak fishing tournament! The fastest and most maneuverable and of them all, this kayak ensures excellent controls and features recognizable badass design that make it apparent - this vessel is truly superior to all the rest!

gear.name: MagFin™ TWKC Impetuous Kayak
gear.description: Ever dreamed of your own vessel? This exclusive limited edition kayak made especially for the Topwater Kayak Cup will make your dream come true! Speed, maneuverability, and ease of control — what more could you ask for an angler who prefers to fish not on the bustling shores, but surrounded with peaceful waters? Except for the catchy, memorable design in the style of the tournament, which stands out brightly among many other faceless kayaks.

gear.name: Native American Canoe
gear.description: This unique canoe is very different from other boats you may come across on the reservoir. This is not surprising: it’s made using technologies invented by Native Americans hundreds of years ago.

gear.name: Kayak Irish Rover
gear.description: The carefree Irish Rover is ready to travel across any body of water and take you to the best fishing spots without any problems. This boat is quite heavy and not very elegant, but as strong as a barrel of the best Irish beer! It will help you feel confident, comfortable, and calm on the water.

gear.name: Anniversary Trolling Kayak
gear.description: Let’s celebrate Fishing Planet Anniversary aboard the Anniversary Trolling Kayak, sporting a one-of-a-kind festive look that stands out on the water! Its pedal-powered control keeps your hands free and removes the need for stamina-recovery pauses, so you can stay focused on trolling. Two extra rod holders and a built-in Echo Sounder give you everything you need to stay on the fish and maximize your haul!
